{1} select a.*, CASE WHEN INSU_NAME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as DISP_FLG from ( select a.UP_DATE, to_char( a.UP_DATE, 'yyyymmdd' ) as start_date, a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'1' AS KEY, a.PATID, '0' as INSU_CLASS, '0' as CTL_NO, '1' as FN_CTL_NO, a.INSURANCE_MEMO1, a.INSURANCE_MEMO2, TRIM(INSURANCE_NO) as INSU_NAME, '0' AS IS_SELECTEDED FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) d on a.PATID=d.PATID where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where a.PATID||a.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) union all select b.UP_DATE, to_char( b.UP_DATE, 'yyyymmdd' ) as start_date, b.PATID||b.CTL_NO||'2' AS KEY, b.PATID, '1' as INSU_CLASS, '1' as CTL_NO, '2' as FN_CTL_NO, b.INSURANCE_MEMO1, b.INSURANCE_MEMO2, TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO1) as INSU_NAME, '0' AS IS_SELECTEDED FROM PAT_INSURANCE b INNER JOIN (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) d on b.PATID=d.PATID where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where b.PATID||b.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and b.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE)
union all select b.UP_DATE, to_char( b.UP_DATE, 'yyyymmdd' ) as start_date, b.PATID||b.CTL_NO||'3' AS KEY, b.PATID, '1' as INSU_CLASS, '2' as CTL_NO, '3' as FN_CTL_NO, b.INSURANCE_MEMO1, b.INSURANCE_MEMO2, TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) as INSU_NAME, '0' AS IS_SELECTEDED FROM PAT_INSURANCE b INNER JOIN (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) d on b.PATID=d.PATID where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where b.PATID||b.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and b.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE)
union all select b.UP_DATE, to_char( b.UP_DATE, 'yyyymmdd' ) as start_date, b.PATID||b.CTL_NO||'4' AS KEY, b.PATID, '2' as INSU_CLASS, '3' as CTL_NO, '4' as FN_CTL_NO, b.INSURANCE_MEMO1, b.INSURANCE_MEMO2, CASE WHEN TRIM(INSURANCE_NO) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(INSURANCE_NO) || CASE WHEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO1) IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO1) ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) ELSE '' END WHEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO1) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO1) || CASE WHEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) ELSE '' END WHEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(PUB_INSU_NO2) ELSE NULL end as INSU_NAME, '1' AS IS_SELECTEDED FROM PAT_INSURANCE b INNER JOIN (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) d on b.PATID=d.PATID where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where b.PATID||b.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and b.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE)
) a INNER JOIN (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=w1.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) d on a.PATID=d.PATID where 1=1 {sqlForSync} {2} order BY KEY

WITH SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST as ( SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' ) ) select * from (SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'1' AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where a.PATID||a.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE)
union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'2' AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where a.PATID||a.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'3' AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO2 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO2 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where a.PATID||a.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO ||'4'AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where not exists(select * from PAT_INSURANCE c where a.PATID||a.CTL_NO = c.PATID||c.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) ) where 1=1 {sqlForSync} order BY KEY

WITH PAT_INSURANCE_LIST AS ( select a.PATID,a.CTL_NO FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) select KEY, '' AS INSU_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB1_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB2_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB3_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB4_CD from (SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'1' AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'2' AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'3' AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO ||'4'AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a ) where 1=1 {sqlForSync} order BY KEY

tableInfo.name: 休日設定
tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select distinct substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) || '1' AS KEY, substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) AS HOLIDAY1, NVL(b.DISP_FLG,0) as DISP_FLG, '1' as class, '0' as DEL_FLG from SYS_RECEIPT_HOLIDAY a left join (select distinct substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) AS KEY, '1' AS DISP_FLG from V_SYS_RECEIPT_HOLIDAY a where ADD_FLG=1 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ORDER BY KEY) b on substr(a.HOLIDAY,0,4)=b.KEY where 1=1 {sqlForSync} {2} union select distinct substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) || '0' AS KEY, substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) AS HOLIDAY1, NVL(b.DISP_FLG,0) as DISP_FLG, '0' as class, '0' as DEL_FLG from SYS_RECEIPT_HOLIDAY a left join (select distinct substr(HOLIDAY,0,4) AS KEY, '1' AS DISP_FLG from V_SYS_RECEIPT_HOLIDAY a where ADD_FLG=1 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ORDER BY KEY) b on substr(a.HOLIDAY,0,4)=b.KEY where 1=1 {sqlForSync} {2} order BY HOLIDAY1,class

child.sqlForTool: SELECT substr(a.HOLIDAY,0,4)|| '1' AS KEY, substr(a.HOLIDAY,0,4) AS HOLIDAY1, to_char(TO_DATE(a.HOLIDAY),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS HOLIDAY2, '2' as class FROM V_SYS_RECEIPT_HOLIDAY a WHERE ADD_FLG=1 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} order BY HOLIDAY

tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select distinct MON_DATA_NAME, DEL_FLG, '2' as VITAL_MONITOR_CLASS,MON_DATA_NO,UP_DATE,DISP_ORDER,MON_KIND_CD FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MON_DATA_NO ORDER BY UP_DATE DESC) rn, MON_DATA_NAME, DEL_FLG,MON_DATA_NO,UP_DATE,DISP_ORDER,MON_KIND_CD FROM MST_MONITOR_ITEM a where MON_DATA_NO >= 10000 AND DEL_FLG = '0' {2} ) b where rn = 1 order by b.DISP_ORDER ASC, MON_KIND_CD ASC, MON_DATA_NO ASC

tableInfo.name: レセプトメモマスタ
tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD ,a.RECEIPT_MEMO_NAME ,case when a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = '004' and b.MONTH_COND='1' then '13' when a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = '004' then '12' else case a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD when '001' then '3' when '002' then '10' when '003' then '9' when '005' then '1' when '006' then '12' when '007' then '4' end end RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD ,TRIM(a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD1) AS IN_HOSPITAL_CD1 ,TRIM(a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD2) AS IN_HOSPITAL_CD2 ,trim(a.DISEASE_CD) as DISEASE_CD ,decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',b.DISP_FLG) as FNSI_DISP_FLG ,case when b.MONTH_SETTING=0 then 2 when b.MONTH_SETTING=1 then 0 else 1 end MONTH_SETTING, b.MONTH_SETTING as add_cnt_1, case a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD when '001' then '1' when '007' then '4' else '0' end as ADDITION_COND, case when a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = '006' then '2' else '1' end as AUTO_CALC, case when a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD in ('005','006','007','002','003','001') then '3' else '0' end as ADDITION_SPAN, case when a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = '007' then '15' else null end as ADDITION_LIMIT,b.DISP_ORDER,a.UP_DATE ,a.DEL_FLG, b.DISP_FLG from MST_RECEIPT_MEMO a inner join MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_SUB_NEW b on(a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD=b.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD) left join MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS c on c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD=a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD where not exists(select * from MST_RECEIPT_MEMO c where a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD=c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) and b.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {2} order by b.DISP_ORDER,b.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD

tableInfo.name: 機械室グラフテンプレート設定
tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select distinct a.TEMPLATE_NO, SUBSTR(a.TEMPLATE_NAME, 1,50) AS TEMPLATE_NAME, a.LEFT_UPPER, a.LEFT_LOWER, a.RIGHT_UPPER, a.RIGHT_LOWER, case b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD when 1 then '002' when 2 then '003' when 3 then '001' end DEVICE_TYPE_CD, case b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD when 2 then 'D' end COM_FORMAT_CD from SYS_MCN_GRAPH_SET a inner join SYS_MCN_GRAPH_SET_DETAIL b on(a.TEMPLATE_NO=b.TEMPLATE_NO) {sqlForSync} order BY TEMPLATE_NO

with SYS_MCN_GRAPH_SET_DETAIL_NEW as( SELECT TEMPLATE_NO, MON_NO, TARGET_VALUE, UPPER_VALUE, LOWER_VALUE, UPPER_LOWER_INPUT_TYPE, TARGET_LINE_DISP_FLG, VERTICAL_AXIS,DEVICE_TYPE_CD, case WHEN COLOR_RED = '0' THEN '00' WHEN COLOR_RED = '1' THEN '01' WHEN COLOR_RED = '2' THEN '02' WHEN COLOR_RED = '3' THEN '03' WHEN COLOR_RED = '4' THEN '04' WHEN COLOR_RED = '5' THEN '05' WHEN COLOR_RED = '6' THEN '06' WHEN COLOR_RED = '7' THEN '07' WHEN COLOR_RED = '8' THEN '08' WHEN COLOR_RED = '9' THEN '09' WHEN COLOR_RED = '10' THEN '0A' WHEN COLOR_RED = '11' THEN '0B' WHEN COLOR_RED = '12' THEN '0C' WHEN COLOR_RED = '13' THEN '0D' WHEN COLOR_RED = '14' THEN '0E' WHEN COLOR_RED = '15' THEN '0F' else to_char(COLOR_RED,'XX') end COLOR_RED1, case WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '0' THEN '00' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '1' THEN '01' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '2' THEN '02' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '3' THEN '03' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '4' THEN '04' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '5' THEN '05' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '6' THEN '06' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '7' THEN '07' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '8' THEN '08' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '9' THEN '09' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '10' THEN '0A' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '11' THEN '0B' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '12' THEN '0C' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '13' THEN '0D' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '14' THEN '0E' WHEN COLOR_GREEN = '15' THEN '0F' else to_char(COLOR_GREEN,'XX') end COLOR_GREEN1, case WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '0' THEN '00' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '1' THEN '01' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '2' THEN '02' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '3' THEN '03' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '4' THEN '04' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '5' THEN '05' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '6' THEN '06' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '7' THEN '07' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '8' THEN '08' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '9' THEN '09' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '10' THEN '0A' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '11' THEN '0B' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '12' THEN '0C' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '13' THEN '0D' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '14' THEN '0E' WHEN COLOR_BLUE = '15' THEN '0F' else to_char(COLOR_BLUE,'XX') end COLOR_BLUE1 FROM SYS_MCN_GRAPH_SET_DETAIL a)
SELECT a.TEMPLATE_NO, a.MON_NO, b.MON_DATA_NAME as MON_DATA_NAME, case b.DECIMAL_FIGURE when 0 then TO_CHAR(a.TARGET_VALUE) when 1 then trim(to_char(a.TARGET_VALUE,'99999.9')) when 2 then trim(to_char(a.TARGET_VALUE,'99999.99')) end as TARGET_VALUE, case b.DECIMAL_FIGURE when 0 then TO_CHAR(a.UPPER_VALUE) when 1 then trim(to_char(a.UPPER_VALUE,'99999.9')) when 2 then trim(to_char(a.UPPER_VALUE,'99999.99')) end as UPPER_VALUE, case b.DECIMAL_FIGURE when 0 then TO_CHAR(abs(a.LOWER_VALUE)) when 1 then trim(to_char(abs(a.LOWER_VALUE),'99999.9')) when 2 then trim(to_char(abs(a.LOWER_VALUE),'99999.99')) end as LOWER_VALUE, UPPER_LOWER_INPUT_TYPE, TARGET_LINE_DISP_FLG, replace('#'||COLOR_RED1||COLOR_GREEN1||COLOR_BLUE1,' ','') AS COLOR, VERTICAL_AXIS FROM SYS_MCN_GRAPH_SET_DETAIL_NEW a left join MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN b on a.MON_NO=b.MON_NO and a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD {sqlForSync} order BY TEMPLATE_NO,MON_NO

tableInfo.name: 日常点検記録
tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select a.DAILY_CHECKLIST_NO||a.DEVICE_NO AS KEY ,a.DAILY_CHECKLIST_NO ,1 as MAINTE_CLASS ,a.DEVICE_NO ,to_char(a.CHECK_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') as CHECK_DATE ,case when a.RESULT=0 then 3 else 1 end RESULT ,trim(a.STAFF_CD) as STAFF_CD ,a.DEL_FLG,mDevice.DEVICE_TYPE_CD,a.UP_DATE ,to_char(a.CHECK_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') as CHECKDATE ,MANUAL_NO_NAME || ' ' || APPENDIX_NO AS category_name , 1 as EDITION from MNT_DAILY_CHECKLIST a INNER JOIN V_MST_DEVICE mDevice on mDevice.DEVICE_NO = a.DEVICE_NO and mDevice.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join V_MST_CHECKLIST_DAILY c on c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=mDevice.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and SUBSTR(c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD, 1, 1) = '0' and c.DEL_FLG='0' where not exists(select * from MNT_DAILY_CHECKLIST c where a.DEVICE_NO =c.DEVICE_NO and a.CHECK_DATE=c.CHECK_DATE and a.UP_DATE<c.UP_DATE) {sqlForSync} {2} order by DEVICE_NO

tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH PLAN_PK AS ( SELECT PERIOD_CHECKPLAN_NO, MAX(a.UP_DATE) MAX_UP_DATE FROM MNT_PERIOD_CHECKPLAN a INNER JOIN V_MST_DEVICE d on d.DEVICE_NO=a.DEVICE_NO and d.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' GROUP BY PERIOD_CHECKPLAN_NO ) ,CHECK_RESULT AS ( SELECT MPC.PERIOD_CHECKLIST_NO ,MPC.PERIOD_CHECKPLAN_NO ,MPC.UP_DATE ,STAFF_CD ,CONFIRMATION_STAFF_CD ,CHECK_STAFF_COMMENT ,RESULT ,RECORD_NUMBER ,MPC.DEL_FLG FROM MNT_PERIOD_CHECKLIST MPC INNER JOIN (SELECT PERIOD_CHECKPLAN_NO, MAX(UP_DATE) MAX_UP_DATE FROM MNT_PERIOD_CHECKLIST GROUP BY PERIOD_CHECKPLAN_NO) PLAN_GROUP ON tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select * from ( select TO_CHAR(a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD) as PAT_GROUP_CD, a.CUSTOM_KEY_NAME, a.DEL_FLG, b.DISP_ORDER, decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',b.DISP_FLG) AS DISP_FLG, null as IN_HOSPITAL_CD, a.up_date from SYS_CUSTOM_KEY a left join SYS_CUSTOM_KEY_DISP b on(a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD=b.CUSTOM_KEY_CD) where SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' order by b.DISP_ORDER NULLS LAST,a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD) a where 1=1 {2} union all select * from ( select distinct PAT_GROUP_CD, PAT_GROUP_NAME as CUSTOM_KEY_NAME, DEL_FLG, 1 as DISP_ORDER, case when DEL_FLG = '1' then '0' else '1' end AS DISP_FLG, a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD, a.up_date from (SELECT PAT_GROUP_CD, UP_DATE, PAT_GROUP_NAME, IN_HOSPITAL_CD, DEL_FLG, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.SERIES_CD, t.PAT_GROUP_CD ORDER BY t.UP_DATE DESC ) AS rn FROM MST_PAT_GROUP t WHERE t.DEL_FLG = '0' ) WHERE rn = 1) a where a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' {2} order by PAT_GROUP_CD ) b

SELECT to_char(to_date(CHECK_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') as CHECK_DATE, RESULT, case WHEN INSTR( a.UNIT, trim(c.UNIT) )>0 THEN trim(c.UNIT) ELSE '' END UNIT, DETAIL, a.SURVEY_POINT_CD, '1' as plan, CASE WHEN a.UNIT IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN c.UNIT IS NULL THEN a.UNIT ELSE CASE WHEN INSTR( a.UNIT, trim(c.UNIT) ) = 0 THEN a.UNIT ELSE SUBSTR( a.UNIT, INSTR(a.UNIT, trim(c.UNIT) ) + LENGTH( trim(c.UNIT) ) ) END END END TEXT, 0 as picker, 0 as inspector, NULL as TIME FROM MNT_WATER_SURVEY a INNER join (select SURVEY_TYPE_CD,SURVEY_POINT_CD FROM MST_WATER_SURVEY_POINT a where a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' and not exists(select * from MST_WATER_SURVEY_POINT b where a.SURVEY_POINT_CD=b.SURVEY_POINT_CD and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE)) b on a.SURVEY_POINT_CD=b.SURVEY_POINT_CD left join (select SURVEY_TYPE_CD,UNIT FROM MST_WATER_SURVEY_TYPE a where not exists(select * from MST_WATER_SURVEY_TYPE b where a.SURVEY_TYPE_CD=b.SURVEY_TYPE_CD and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE)) c on c.SURVEY_TYPE_CD=b.SURVEY_TYPE_CD
where NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM MNT_WATER_SURVEY B WHERE a.SURVEY_POINT_CD=B.SURVEY_POINT_CD AND a.SURVEY_RECORD_NO=B.SURVEY_RECORD_NO AND a.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE) and a.DEL_FLG = '0' {sqlForSync}

decode(b.MEDI_ACH_FLG,'1','1','0') AS MEDI_ACH_FLG, b.DISP_ORDER, case when c.len is null then 2 else c.len end as point ,ACTIVE_INGREDIENT,CAPACITY, 1 as UNIT_CONVERTED_AMOUNT,a.up_date FROM MST_MEDICINE a INNER JOIN MST_MEDICINE_SUB_NEW b ON ( a.MEDICINE_CD = b.MEDICINE_CD AND a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE ) INNER JOIN SYNC_FACILITY_CD f on f.SERIES_CD=b.SERIES_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEDICINE_CD, case when instr(CONVERSION_VALUE,'.')=0 then 0 else length(substr(CONVERSION_VALUE,instr(CONVERSION_VALUE,'.')+1)) end len FROM ( SELECT t.MEDICINE_CD, t.CONVERSION_VALUE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY plla.MEDICINE_CD ORDER BY plla.UP_DATE DESC ) rn, plla.MEDICINE_CD, plla.CONVERSION_VALUE FROM MST_MEDICINE_GROUP_DETAIL plla ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) m ) c on a.MEDICINE_CD=c.MEDICINE_CD WHERE b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} {2} ORDER BY b.DISP_ORDER NULLS LAST,a.MEDICINE_CD) a union all SELECT * FROM ( select * from ( SELECT '0' as IS_TRIAL, 'TS' || SUBSTR(a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, 3) AS MEDICINE_CD , a.SET_MEDICINE_NAME || '(調剤)' AS MEDICINE_NAME , a.IND_UNIT AS UNIT , a.UNIT AS UNIT_SECOND , a.MEDICINE_GROUP_CD AS MEDICINE_GROUP_CD , null as WALFARE_CD, TRIM( a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD ) AS IN_HOSPITAL_CD, TRIM( a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD2 ) AS IN_HOSPITAL_CD2, decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',msmsn.DISP_FLG) AS DISP_FLG, null AS how_to_use, null AS VALID_TERM_MIN, null AS VALID_TERM_MAX, null AS SHOT, null AS MEDICINE_CLASS_CD, decode(msmsn.MEDI_ACH_FLG,'1','1','0') AS MEDI_ACH_FLG, msmsn.DISP_ORDER, 2 AS point, null AS ACTIVE_INGREDIENT, null AS CAPACITY, 1 as UNIT_CONVERTED_AMOUNT,a.up_date FROM MST_SET_MEDI_NAME a INNER JOIN MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_SUB_NEW msmsn ON a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = msmsn.SET_MEDICINE_CD AND a.UP_DATE = msmsn.UP_DATE WHERE msmsn.SERIES_CD = child.sqlForTool: WITH MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_LIST AS( select a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, a.SET_MEDICINE_NAME, a.MEDICINE_GROUP_CD from MST_SET_MEDI_NAME a inner join MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_SUB_NEW b on(a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = b.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) select a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, a.MEDICINE_CD, a.STANDARD_UNIT, a.MEDI_USE_NUM, case s.MEDICINE_GROUP_CD when '301' then 1 else 0 end AS solvent from MST_SET_MEDICINE a INNER JOIN MST_MEDICINE b on a.MEDICINE_CD = b.MEDICINE_CD LEFT JOIN MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_LIST s on s.SET_MEDICINE_CD = a.SET_MEDICINE_CD where not exists( select * from MST_SET_MEDICINE b where a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = b.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.MEDICINE_CD = b.MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE) and exists( select * from MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_SUB_NEW c where a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = c.SET_MEDICINE_CD) and not exists( select * from MST_MEDICINE c where b.MEDICINE_CD = c.MEDICINE_CD and b.UP_DATE < c.UP_DATE) and not exists( select * from MST_MEDICINE_SUB_NEW d where b.MEDICINE_CD = d.MEDICINE_CD and d.DISP_FLG = '0') and not exists ( select 1 from MST_MEDICINE m where m.MEDICINE_CD = a.MEDICINE_CD and m.DEL_FLG = '1' and m.UP_DATE = ( select max(m2.UP_DATE) from MST_MEDICINE m2 where m2.MEDICINE_CD = m.MEDICINE_CD)) and a.DEL_FLG = '0' {sqlForSync} order by a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, a.MEDICINE_CD

tableInfo.sqlForTool: with SERIAL_LIST AS ( select DEVICE_NO,trim(DEVICE_SERIAL) as DEVICE_SERIAL from mst_device a where not exists(select * from mst_device b where a.device_no=b.device_no and a.up_date<b.up_date) union all select DEVICE_NO,trim(DEVICE_SERIAL) as DEVICE_SERIAL from mst_machine a where not exists(select * from mst_machine b where a.device_no=b.device_no and a.up_date<b.up_date) ),FTP_FLG_TABLE AS ( SELECT FTP_FLG, a.UP_DATE FROM SYS_COMSVR_SETTING a where not exists(select * from SYS_COMSVR_SETTING b where a.COMSVR_NO=b.COMSVR_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) ) {1} select a.DEVICE_NO,nvl(DEVICE_TYPE_CD,'999') AS DEVICE_TYPE_CD,'0' AS IS_FTP,FTP_FLG AS IS_VA, case WHEN DEVICE_MODEL_CD ='002' and (DEVICE_TYPE_CD is null or DEVICE_TYPE_CD=' ' ) then 'F' else DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD end as DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD, case when (trim(a.device_serial) )is null then 'd' || a.device_no else case when (1<(select count(*) from SERIAL_LIST n where trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL)=n.DEVICE_SERIAL)) then 'd'||a.device_no else SUBSTR(trim(a.device_serial),1,8) end end device_serial, '' as DEVICE_EDGE_NO, CASE WHEN DEL_FLG = '1' OR FAIL_FLG = '1' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DISP_FLG, DEVICE_NAME, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(IP_ADDRESS, '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$') THEN IP_ADDRESS ELSE NULL END AS IP_ADDRESS, PORT_NO,SETTING_DATE,DELETE_DATE,FAIL_FLG,'' AS DEVICE_OPTION,VERSION, case WHEN a.MEMO IS NOT NULL and c.MEMO is not null THEN a.MEMO || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || c.MEMO WHEN c.MEMO is not null THEN c.MEMO ELSE a.MEMO end as MEMO, MODE0,MODE1,MODE2,MODE3,MODE4,MODE5,MODE6,MODE7,MODE8,MODE10,TMP_CENTER_HD,TMP_CENTER_ECUM,TMP_CENTER_HDF,TMP_CENTER_HF,TMP_CENTER_HD_HO,TMP_CENTER_OHDF,TMP_CENTER_OHF, CASE WHEN DEVICE_MODEL_CD ='001' THEN 1 WHEN DEVICE_MODEL_CD ='999' then 0 WHEN DEVICE_MODEL_CD ='002' and (DEVICE_TYPE_CD is null or DEVICE_TYPE_CD=' ' ) then 0 ELSE 3 END AS COM_TYPE,'0' as FN_CLASS_CD,a.UP_DATE,'1' AS is_support_blood_purify from MST_DEVICE a left join FTP_FLG_TABLE b on 1=1 left join (select DEVICE_NO, '型式：「'||trim(a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD)||'」と製造番号：「'||trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL)||'」が重複しています。' as MEMO FROM MST_DEVICE a INNER JOIN (SELECT DEVICE_TYPE_CD, DEVICE_SERIAL FROM MST_DEVICE a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_DEVICE b WHERE a.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE ) GROUP BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, DEVICE_SERIAL,SERIES_CD HAVING COUNT(*)> 1 and trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL) is not null and trim(a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD) is not null and a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) b on a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and a.DEVICE_SERIAL=b.DEVICE_SERIAL and a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_DEVICE b WHERE a.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE )) c on c.DEVICE_NO=a.DEVICE_NO where not exists(select * from MST_DEVICE b where a.DEVICE_NO=b.DEVICE_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} {2} order by device_no

tableInfo.sqlForTool: with SERIAL_LIST AS ( select DEVICE_NO,trim(DEVICE_SERIAL) as DEVICE_SERIAL from mst_device a where not exists(select * from mst_device b where a.device_no=b.device_no and a.up_date<b.up_date) union all select DEVICE_NO,trim(DEVICE_SERIAL) as DEVICE_SERIAL from mst_machine a where not exists(select * from mst_machine b where a.device_no=b.device_no and a.up_date<b.up_date) ) {1} select a.DEVICE_NO, case when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='1' and DEVICE_ID='A' and DEVICE_VERSION=1 then 180 when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='2' and DEVICE_ID='D' and DEVICE_VERSION=1 then 260 when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='3' and DEVICE_ID='R' and DEVICE_VERSION=2 then 290 when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='4' and DEVICE_ID='I' and DEVICE_VERSION=1 then 262 when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='5' and DEVICE_ID='J' and DEVICE_VERSION=1 then 263 when DEVICE_TYPE_CD='3' and DEVICE_ID='R' and DEVICE_VERSION=1 then 291 else 999 end AS DEVICE_TYPE_CD, '0' AS IS_FTP,'0' AS IS_VA, case when (trim(a.device_serial) )is null then 'm'||a.device_no else case when (1<(select count(*) from SERIAL_LIST n where trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL)=n.DEVICE_SERIAL)) then 'm'||a.device_no else SUBSTR(trim(a.device_serial),1,8) end end device_serial, a.DEVICE_ID AS DEVICE_ID, a.DEVICE_NAME, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(IP_ADDRESS, '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$') THEN IP_ADDRESS ELSE NULL END AS IP_ADDRESS, a.PORT_NO,2 AS COM_TYPE, decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0','1') AS DISP_FLG ,a.SETTING_DATE,a.DELETE_DATE,a.DEVICE_VERSION, case WHEN a.MEMO IS NOT NULL and c.MEMO is not null THEN a.MEMO || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || c.MEMO WHEN c.MEMO is not null THEN c.MEMO ELSE a.MEMO end as MEMO, '' as DEVICE_EDGE_NO,'1' as FN_CLASS_CD,a.UP_DATE, '0' as IS_SUPPORT, '-30' as TMP_HD, '-65' as TMP_ECUM from mst_machine a left join (select DEVICE_NO, '型式：「'||trim(a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD)||'」と製造番号：「'||trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL)||'」が重複しています。' as MEMO FROM mst_machine a INNER JOIN (SELECT DEVICE_TYPE_CD, DEVICE_SERIAL FROM mst_machine a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM mst_machine b WHERE a.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE ) GROUP BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, DEVICE_SERIAL,SERIES_CD HAVING COUNT(*)> 1 and trim(a.DEVICE_SERIAL) is not null and trim(a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD) is not null and a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) b on a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and a.DEVICE_SERIAL=b.DEVICE_SERIAL and a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM mst_machine b WHERE a.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE )) c on c.DEVICE_NO=a.DEVICE_NO where not exists(select * from MST_MACHINE b where a.DEVICE_NO=b.DEVICE_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND a.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' AND a.DEVICE_ID IS NOT NULL AND a.DEVICE_ID <> 'E' {sqlForSync} {2} order by device_no

FROM MST_STAFF X INNER JOIN ( SELECT STAFF_CD , MAX(UP_DATE) AS MAX_UP_DATE FROM MST_STAFF GROUP BY STAFF_CD ) Y ON X.STAFF_CD = Y.STAFF_CD AND X.UP_DATE = Y.MAX_UP_DATE) a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT trim(staff_cd) as staff_cd, disp_order, DISP_FLG FROM sys_staff_disp WHERE series_cd = '{SERIES_CD}' ) b ON ( trim(a.staff_cd) = b.staff_cd ) ),JOB_CLASS_CD_LIST AS( select TO_CHAR(JOB_CLASS_CD) AS JOB_CLASS_CD from MST_JOB a where not exists(select * from MST_JOB b where a.JOB_CLASS_CD=b.JOB_CLASS_CD and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and JOB_CLASS_NAME!='未登録' ) {1} SELECT case when instr(trim_name,' ')=0 then trim_name when instr(trim_name,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name,0,instr(trim_name,' ')-1) end as sei, case when instr(trim_name,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name,instr(trim_name,' ')+1) else null end as mei, case when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')=0 then trim_name_kana when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name_kana,0,instr(trim_name_kana,' ')-1) else null end as sei_kana, case when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name_kana,instr(trim_name_kana,' ')+1) else null end as mei_kana, trim(a.staff_cd) as staff_cd, a.staff_address, a.staff_address_kana, a.tel, a.tel2, a.fax, a.email, j.job_class_cd, a.nkk_auth, a.disp_order, 0 AS user_type, a.DRUG_LICENSE_NO, decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',a.DISP_FLG_1) AS DISP_FLG_1, NVL(NVL(c.administrator,d.administrator),e.administrator) AS administrator,a.UP_DATE ,a.DEL_FLG AS IS_DEL FROM MST_STAFF_NORMAL a left outer join admin_user_authority_list c on(a.STAFF_CD = c.FNW_STAFF_CD) left outer join job_authority_list d on(a.JOB_CLASS_CD=d.FNW_JOB_CLASS_CD) left join JOB_CLASS_CD_list j on j.JOB_CLASS_CD=a.job_class_cd cross join job_authority_list_default e {sqlForSync} {2} ORDER BY a.DISP_FLG_1 desc,disp_order,staff_cd

SYS_CARD_IDM_INFO f ON ( a.STAFF_CD = f.STAFF_CD ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SYS_STAFF_AUTH.STAFF_CD, TO_CHAR(LISTAGG(CASE WHEN STAFF_AUTH_CD = '01' and (ACL =3 OR ACL =4) THEN '''013''' WHEN STAFF_AUTH_CD = '02' and (ACL =3 OR ACL =4) THEN '''023'',''033''' WHEN STAFF_AUTH_CD = '03' and (ACL =3 OR ACL =4) THEN '''133'',''063''' WHEN STAFF_AUTH_CD = '04' and ACL =2 THEN '''052'',''072'',''082''' WHEN STAFF_AUTH_CD))AS STAFF_AUTH_CD FROM SYS_STAFF_AUTH, v_mst_staff WHERE v_mst_staff.STAFF_CD = SYS_STAFF_AUTH.STAFF_CD GROUP BY SYS_STAFF_AUTH.STAFF_CD ) d ON ( a.STAFF_CD = d.STAFF_CD ) ) a LEFT OUTER tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select a.COMSVR_NO, a.LCD_LOG, a.LCD_LOG2, a.LCD_MEDICATION_TIMING_DISP, a.HAI_COUNT, CASE a.LEAVE_FLG WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 END AS LEAVE_FLG, case a.MEDI_ALERT_ADJUST_MINUTES when -1 then 0 else a.MEDI_ALERT_ADJUST_MINUTES*60 end as MEDI_ALERT_ADJUST_MINUTES, case a.MEDI_ALERT_ADJUST_MINUTES when -1 then 0 else 1 end as IS_NOTICE, a.MENU1_TITLE, a.MENU2_TITLE, a.MENU3_TITLE, a.MENU4_TITLE, '' as LCD_MENU, '' as LCD_NPAT, '' as LCD_REPORT, '' as LCD_GRAPH1, '' as LCD_GRAPH2, '' as LCD_RADAR, '' as LCD_STAFF_LIST, TO_CHAR(a.BROADCAST_TIMING,'hh24mi') AS BROADCAST_TIMING, a.TIME_BROADCAST_FLG, TO_CHAR(b.BROADCAST_TIMING,'hh24mi') as TIMESET_NX_TIME, b.TIME_BROADCAST_FLG as IS_TIMESET_NX, a.NPAT_TWOITEMS_IN_ONEROW_DISP, 20 as treat_realtime_monito_interval, 300 as other_realtime_monito_interval, MEDI_CHANGE_ALERT_FLG,SCN_TIME*60 AS SCN_TIME,a.UP_DATE ,sys48.VALUE AS next_pat_mode, CASE WHEN sys48.VALUE = '1' THEN sys49.VALUE WHEN sys48.VALUE = '2' THEN sys50.VALUE END AS next_pat_mode_range from SYS_COMSVR_SETTING a left outer join SYS_MCNSVR_SETTING b on a.COMSVR_NO=b.MCN_SERVER_NO CROSS JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN VALUE='0' THEN '1' WHEN VALUE='1' THEN '2' end as VALUE FROM SYS_SYSTEM_DEFINE WHERE ID = 48 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) sys48 CROSS JOIN (SELECT VALUE FROM SYS_SYSTEM_DEFINE WHERE ID = 49 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') sys49 CROSS JOIN (SELECT VALUE FROM SYS_SYSTEM_DEFINE WHERE ID = 50 and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') sys50 where not exists(select * from SYS_COMSVR_SETTING b where a.COMSVR_NO=b.COMSVR_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) {sqlForSync} {2} order by COMSVR_NO

with scs as( select a.* from SYS_COMSVR_SETTING a where not exists(select * from SYS_COMSVR_SETTING b where a.COMSVR_NO=b.COMSVR_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) ), stf as( SELECT trim(st.STAFF_CD) as STAFF_CD, st.DEVICE_DISP_NO FROM MST_STAFF st WHERE st.UP_DATE = ( SELECT MAX( b.UP_DATE ) FROM MST_STAFF b WHERE st.STAFF_CD = b.STAFF_CD ) and DEL_FLG = '0' and DEVICE_DISP_FLG = '0' ORDER BY st.DEVICE_DISP_NO, st.UP_DATE, st.STAFF_CD ), stfsort AS( SELECT stf.*, rownum as rn FROM stf ) SELECT b.COMSVR_NO, a.DEVICE_DISP_NO, a.STAFF_CD, a.rn AS "ROWNUM" FROM stfsort a CROSS JOIN scs b {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.rn

tableInfo.name: 検査項目マスタ
tableInfo.sqlForTool: with MST_EXAM_CALC as( select a.EXAM_ITEM_CD, max(UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, listagg(CALC_ITEM_CD,',') within group(order by CALC_ITEM_CD) as CALC_ITEM_CD, listagg(CALC_ITEM_NAME,',') within group(order by CALC_ITEM_CD) as CALC_ITEM_NAME from MST_EXAM_CALC_ITEM a where a.EXAM_ITEM_CD is not null and not exists(select * from MST_EXAM_CALC_ITEM b where a.CALC_ITEM_CD=b.CALC_ITEM_CD and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) group by EXAM_ITEM_CD ) {1} select a.EXAM_ITEM_CD, TRIM(a.EXAM_ITEM_NAME) as EXAM_ITEM_NAME, a.DATA_TYPE, a.UNIT, TO_CHAR(a.NORMAL_VALUE_UPPER,'FM9999990.00') as NORMAL_VALUE_UPPER, TO_CHAR(a.NORMAL_VALUE_LOWER,'FM9999990.00') as NORMAL_VALUE_LOWER, a.INPUT_INTEGER_FIGURE, case when DATA_TYPE=0 then null else a.INPUT_DECIMAL_FIGURE end as INPUT_DECIMAL_FIGURE, TO_CHAR(a.INPUT_UPPER,'FM9999990.00') as INPUT_UPPER, TO_CHAR(a.INPUT_LOWER,'FM9999990.00') as INPUT_LOWER, TRIM(a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD) as IN_HOSPITAL_CD, TRIM(a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD2) as IN_HOSPITAL_CD2, TRIM(a.IN_HOSPITAL_CD3) as IN_HOSPITAL_CD3, decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',b.DISP_FLG) AS DISP_FLG, nvl2(b.LCD_ORDER,1,0) as CONSOLE_CLASS, TO_CHAR(b.GRAPH_UPPER,'FM9999990.00') as GRAPH_UPPER, TO_CHAR(b.GRAPH_LOWER,'FM9999990.00') as GRAPH_LOWER ,case a.EXAM_ITEM_CD when 'NKK9999101' then '1' when 'NKK9999102' then '2' when 'NKK9999103' then '3' when 'NKK9999104' then '4' when 'NKK9999105' then '5' when 'NKK9999106' then '6' when 'NKK9999107' then '7' when 'NKK9999109' then '8' when 'NKK9999110' then '9' when 'NKK9999111' then '10' when 'NKK9999112' then '11' when 'NKK9999113' then '12' when 'NKK9999114' then '13' when 'NKK9999115' then '14' when 'NKK9999116' then '15' else case CALC_ITEM_CD when '001' then '1' when '002' then '1' when '001,002' then '1' when '003' then '4' when '004' then '4' when '003,004' then '4' when '005' then '2' when '006' then '2' when '005,006' then '2' when '007' then '3' when '008' then '3' when '007,008' then '3' when '009' then '8' when '010' then '8' when '009,010' then '8' when '011' then '10' when '012' then '10' when '011,012' then '10' when '013' then '9' when '014' then '9' when '013,014' then '9' when '015' then '7' when '016' then '7' when '015,016' then '7' when '017' then '11' when '018' then '11' when '017,018' then '11' when '019' then '12' when '020' then '12' when '019,020' then '12' when '021' then '13' when '022' then '13' when '021,022' then '13' when '023' then '14' when '024' then '14' when '023,024' then '14' when '025' then '15' when '026' then '15' when '025,026' then '15' when '027' then '5' when '028' then '6' when '999' then '0' else '0' end end CALC_ITEM_CD, case when a.EXAM_ITEM_CD like '%NKK9999%' and ((substr(a.EXAM_ITEM_CD,8,3) between 101 and 107) or (substr(a.EXAM_ITEM_CD,8,3) between 109 and 116)) then '1' else '0' end as EXAM_CLASS, case when a.EXAM_ITEM_CD like '%NKK9999%' and ((substr(a.EXAM_ITEM_CD,8,3) between 101 and 107) or (substr(a.EXAM_ITEM_CD,8,3) between 109 and 116)) then '0' else case when (LENGTH(CALC_ITEM_CD) - LENGTH(REPLACE(CALC_ITEM_CD, ',', '')) + 1) = 1 then case when CALC_ITEM_CD IN ('001','003','005','007','009','011','013','015','017','019','021','023','025','027','028') then '1' when CALC_ITEM_CD IN ('002','004','006','008','010','012','014','016','018','020','022','024','026') then '2' else '0' end when (LENGTH(CALC_ITEM_CD) - LENGTH(REPLACE(CALC_ITEM_CD, ',', '')) + 1) = 2 and CALC_ITEM_CD IN ('001,002','003,004','005,006','007,008','009,010','011,012','013,014','015,016','017,018','019,020','021,022','023,024','025,026') then '3' else '0' end end as DIALYSIS_PROGRESS_FLAG, case when (LENGTH(CALC_ITEM_CD) - LENGTH(REPLACE(CALC_ITEM_CD, ',', '')) + 1) > 2 then '1' else '0' end as LOG_FLG, c.CALC_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, c.CALC_ITEM_CD AS ITEM_CD,b.DISP_ORDER,a.REG_DATE,nvl(IN_HOSP_FLG,'0') as IN_HOSP_FLG from mst_exam_item a inner join MST_EXAM_ITEM_SUB_NEW b on (a.EXAM_ITEM_CD = b.EXAM_ITEM_CD and a.REG_DATE = b.REG_DATE) left join MST_EXAM_CALC c on(a.EXAM_ITEM_CD = c.EXAM_ITEM_CD) LEFT JOIN ( select EXAM_ITEM_CD ,case when IN_HOSP_FLG = '1' then '0' else '1' end as IN_HOSP_FLG ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_ITEM_CD ORDER BY b.UP_DATE DESC) rn from MST_EXAM_SET_DETAIL a INNER JOIN ( SELECT decode(a.DEL_FLG,'1','0',b.DISP_FLG) AS DISP_FLG ,IN_HOSP_FLG, a.EXAM_KIND_CD||a.EXAM_SET_CD as EXAM_SET_CD,a.UP_DATE from MST_EXAM_SET a inner join MST_EXAM_SET_SUB_NEW b on (a.EXAM_KIND_CD = b.EXAM_KIND_CD and a.EXAM_SET_CD = b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and not substr(a.EXAM_SET_CD,1,1)='X' ) b on a.EXAM_KIND_CD||a.EXAM_SET_CD =b.EXAM_SET_CD WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_EXAM_SET_DETAIL b WHERE a.EXAM_KIND_CD = b.EXAM_KIND_CD and a.EXAM_SET_CD = b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.EXAM_ITEM_CD = b.EXAM_ITEM_CD AND a.UP_DATE <b.UP_DATE ) AND b.DISP_FLG=1 and a.DEL_FLG=0 ) f on f.EXAM_ITEM_CD=a.EXAM_ITEM_CD and rn = 1 where b.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} {2} order by b.DISP_ORDER nulls last,a.EXAM_ITEM_CD

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.*, regexp_replace(replace(ltrim(rtrim(name,' '),' '),' ',' '),'\s{2,}',' ') as trim_name, regexp_replace(replace(ltrim(rtrim(name_kana,' '),' '),' ',' '),'\s{2,}',' ') as trim_name_kana FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE ) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=w1.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) {1} SELECT PATID, CASE ISCHECKED WHEN '2' THEN ltrim(DISP_PATID,'0') WHEN '3' THEN substr(DISP_PATID, LINENUMBER) ELSE DISP_PATID END AS DISP_PATID, case when instr(trim_name,' ')=0 then trim_name when instr(trim_name,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name,0,instr(trim_name,' ')-1) end as sei, case when instr(trim_name,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name,instr(trim_name,' ')+1) else ' ' end as mei, case when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')=0 then trim_name_kana when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name_kana,0,instr(trim_name_kana,' ')-1) end as sei_kana, case when instr(trim_name_kana,' ')>0 then substr(trim_name_kana,instr(trim_name_kana,' ')+1) else ' ' end as mei_kana, NAME,NAME_KANA,BIRTHDAY,SEX_CD,BLOOD_TYPE_ABO,BLOOD_TYPE_RH, CASE WHEN a.DIE_FLG = '1' THEN '2' ELSE a.INOUT_FLG END AS INOUT_FLG, DIE_FLG,DIE_CD,DIE_DATE,INJURY_CD,TRANSPORT_CD,trim(BASE_DISEASE_CD) as BASE_DISEASE_CD,REG_DATE,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL a INNER JOIN SYNC_CONDSET s on s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} {2} {3} ORDER BY PATID

WITH DIFF_COMENT AS ( SELECT A.DIAL_DIFF_CD FROM MST_DIAL_DIFF_COMENT A WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_DIAL_DIFF_COMENT B WHERE A.DIAL_DIFF_CD = B.DIAL_DIFF_CD AND A.UP_DATE < B.UP_DATE ) AND A.DEL_FLG = '0' ), BASDIFF AS ( SELECT PA.PATID, PA.DIAL_DIFF_COM_CD AS CODE, PA.REG_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO PA INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=PA.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO PB WHERE PA.PATID = PB.PATID AND PA.REG_DATE < PB.REG_DATE ) ), RECEIPT_MEMO AS ( SELECT A.PATID, A.CODE, '0' AS IS_MAIN, A.UP_DATE AS REG_DATE, A.ADD_FLG FROM PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO A WHERE A.DIVISION = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO B WHERE A.PATID = B.PATID AND B.DIVISION = '0' AND A.CODE = B.CODE AND A.UP_DATE < B.UP_DATE ) AND A.ADD_FLG = '1' AND '1'= (SELECT VALUE FROM SYS_SYSTEM_DEFINE WHERE ID = '134' AND SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASDIFF B WHERE A.CODE = B.CODE AND A.PATID = B.PATID ) ), BASE_TOTAL AS ( SELECT A.PATID, B.DIAL_DIFF_CD AS CODE, DECODE( A.CODE, B.DIAL_DIFF_CD, '1', NULL ) AS IS_MAIN, DECODE( A.CODE, B.DIAL_DIFF_CD, A.REG_DATE, NULL ) AS REG_DATE, DECODE( A.CODE, B.DIAL_DIFF_CD, '1', NULL ) AS ADD_FLG FROM BASDIFF A, DIFF_COMENT B ) SELECT A.PATID, A.CODE, COALESCE( A.REG_DATE, B.REG_DATE ) AS REG_DATE, COALESCE( A.IS_MAIN, B.IS_MAIN, '0' ) AS IS_MAIN, COALESCE( A.ADD_FLG, B.ADD_FLG, '0' ) AS DIAL_DIFF FROM BASE_TOTAL A LEFT JOIN RECEIPT_MEMO B ON A.PATID = B.PATID AND A.CODE = B.CODE {sqlForSync}

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW AS( SELECT PATID,DIE_CD,DIE_DATE,BASE_DISEASE_CD FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a where NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO b where a.PATID = b.PATID and a.REG_DATE<b.REG_DATE) ), PAT_MEDICAL_HST_NEW AS ( SELECT PATID, CTL_NO, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_YEAR, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_MONTH, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_CD, DISEASE_DATE, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'yyyy') AS DISEASE_YEAR, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'mm') AS DISEASE_MONTH, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'dd') AS DISEASE_DAY, MAIN_DISEASE, STATUS, RECOVER_DATE, NOTICE_FLG, NULL AS FACILITY_NAME_MEMO, case when DOCTOR_NAME is not null then '診断医：'||DOCTOR_NAME||CHR(13)||CHR(10) else '' end DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO, case when DOCTOR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE, DOCTOR_NAME as DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, MEMO,UP_DATE FROM PAT_MEDICAL_HST a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_MEDICAL_HST b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND a.DEL_FLG = '0' ), PAT_INOUT_DIE_NEW AS ( SELECT PATID, 0 AS CTL_NO, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'yyyy') AS DIAGNOSIS_YEAR, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'mm') AS DIAGNOSIS_MONTH, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'dd') AS DIAGNOSIS_DAY, NULL AS DISEASE_CD, NULL AS DISEASE_DATE, NULL AS DISEASE_YEAR, NULL AS DISEASE_MONTH, NULL AS DISEASE_DAY, NULL AS MAIN_DISEASE, '1' AS STATUS, NULL as RECOVER_DATE, NULL AS NOTICE_FLG, case when FACILITY_NAME is not null then '施設：'||FACILITY_NAME||' ' else '' end FACILITY_NAME_MEMO, case when DR_NAME is not null then '診断医：'||DR_NAME||' ' else '' end DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO, case when DR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE, DR_NAME as DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, NULL AS MEMO,UP_DATE FROM PAT_INOUT a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_INOUT b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND INOUT_CD='3' AND DEL_FLG = '0' ) SELECT '0' AS IS_CONFIRMATION_BIOPSY, '0' AS IS_DIAGNOSED, a.PATID, a.DIE_DATE, DECODE(CTL_NO,0,MAX(CTL_NO) OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID) + 1,CTL_NO) AS CTL_NO, a.DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,a.DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,a.DIAGNOSIS_DAY, a.DISEASE_YEAR,a.DISEASE_MONTH,a.DISEASE_DAY,a.DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,a.DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, a.IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS, a.DISEASE_CD,a.IS_DIE,a.DISEASE_DATE,a.MAIN_DISEASE,a.STATUS,TO_CHAR(RECOVER_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as RECOVER_DATE,case when a.NOTICE_FLG='0' then '1' else '0' end as NOTICE_FLG ,a.MEMO ,'0' AS COURSE_IS_FREE,'0' AS DIAGNOSIS_FACILITY_IS_FREE, row_number ( ) over ( PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY DISEASE_DATE DESC,a.UP_DATE DESC ) AS DISP_ORDER, '0' AS DISEASE_END_INPUT_FREE, '0' AS DIAGNOSIS_END_INPUT_FREE, '0' AS DISEASE_START_INPUT_FREE, '0' AS DIAGNOSIS_START_INPUT_FREE, (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') as FNSI_FACILITY_CD FROM ( SELECT a.PATID,null as DIE_DATE, CTL_NO, DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_YEAR,DISEASE_MONTH,DISEASE_DAY,DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, case when a.DISEASE_CD=b.BASE_DISEASE_CD then '1' else '0' end as IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS, DISEASE_CD,'0' AS IS_DIE,DISEASE_DATE,MAIN_DISEASE,STATUS,RECOVER_DATE,NOTICE_FLG,FACILITY_NAME_MEMO||DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO||MEMO AS MEMO,UP_DATE FROM PAT_MEDICAL_HST_NEW a LEFT OUTER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW b ON(a.PATID=b.PATID) UNION SELECT a.PATID,b.DIE_DATE,CTL_NO,DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_YEAR,DISEASE_MONTH,DISEASE_DAY,DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, NULL as IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS, b.DIE_CD as DISEASE_CD,'1' AS IS_DIE,DISEASE_DATE,MAIN_DISEASE,STATUS,RECOVER_DATE,NOTICE_FLG,FACILITY_NAME_MEMO||DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO||MEMO,UP_DATE AS MEMO FROM PAT_INOUT_DIE_NEW a LEFT OUTER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW b ON(a.PATID=b.PATID) ) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID, DISEASE_DATE DESC,a.UP_DATE DESC

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.* FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) ,MST_FACILITY_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.* FROM mst_facility w1 where NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mst_facility b WHERE w1.facility_cd=b.facility_cd AND w1.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE)) select a.*,'0' as COURSE_IS_FREE from ( SELECT a.PATID, case when c.PATID is null then CTL_NO else CTL_NO + 1 END AS CTL_NO, case when a.INOUT_CD = '2' then '3' when a.INOUT_CD = '3' then '11' when a.INOUT_CD = '4' then '3' when a.INOUT_CD = '5' then '7' when a.INOUT_CD = '6' then '8' when a.INOUT_CD = '7' then '9' when a.INOUT_CD = '1' then '2' end as INOUT_CD, FACILITY_CD AS FACILITY_CD, case when DR_NAME is not null then '担当医：'||DR_NAME||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||a.MEMO else a.MEMO end as MEMO, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as REG_DATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyy') as REG_DATE_YEAR, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'mm') as REG_DATE_MONTH, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'dd') as REG_DATE_DAY, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '1', '3', '5', '6' ) then a.FACILITY_NAME else (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') end as FROM_FACILITY, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '2', '4' ,'7' ) then a.FACILITY_NAME else '' end as TO_FACILITY, case when a.FACILITY_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end as FACILITY_IS_FREE, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '2', '4', '7' ) then a.DR_NAME else '' end as TO_DOCTOR, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '1', '3', '5', '6' ) then a.DR_NAME else '' end as FROM_DOCTOR, case when a.DR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end as DOCTOR_IS_FREE, CASE WHEN a.INOUT_CD IN ('2', '4', '5', '6', '7') THEN '3' WHEN a.INOUT_CD = '3' THEN '2' ELSE CASE WHEN b.INOUT_FLG = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END END AS INOUT, 'true' as IN_OUT_CHECK, null as READONLY, 0 as DISP_ORDER, (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') as FNSI_FACILITY_CD, '0' as PERIOD_START_INPUT_FREE, '0' as PERIOD_END_INPUT_FREE, null as PERIOD_END_DATE FROM PAT_INOUT a left join PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL b on a.PATID = b.PATID left join PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL c ON a.PATID = c.PATID AND c.DIAL_START_DATE IS NOT NULL WHERE INOUT_CD IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_INOUT b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND a.DEL_FLG = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL c WHERE c.PATID = a.PATID AND a.INOUT_CD = 1 AND c.DIAL_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND a.REG_DATE = c.DIAL_START_DATE ) union all select a.PATID,1 as CTL_NO, '1' as INOUT_CD, INSTITUTION_CD as FACILITY_CD, '' as MEMO, a.DIAL_START_DATE as REG_DATE, a.DIAL_START_DATE as REG_DATE_DATE, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 1, 4) as REG_DATE_YEAR, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 5, 2) as REG_DATE_MONTH, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 7, 2) as REG_DATE_DAY, b.FACILITY_NAME as FROM_FACILITY, '' as TO_FACILITY, '1' as FACILITY_IS_FREE, '' as TO_DOCTOR, '' as FROM_DOCTOR, '0' as DOCTOR_IS_FREE, CASE WHEN a.INOUT_FLG = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS INOUT, 'true' as IN_OUT_CHECK, null as READONLY, 0 as DISP_ORDER, (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') as FNSI_FACILITY_CD, '0' as PERIOD_START_INPUT_FREE, '0' as PERIOD_END_INPUT_FREE, null as PERIOD_END_DATE from PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL a left join MST_FACILITY_NORMAL b on a.INSTITUTION_CD=b.FACILITY_CD where DIAL_START_DATE is not null) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where 1=1 {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,CTL_NO

WITH DIALYSIS_DATE_list as ( SELECT PATID,DIALYSIS_DATE FROM (select PATID,IND_START_DATE as DIALYSIS_DATE from IND_DIALYSIS_COND WHERE CTL_NO = '004' UNION ALL select PATID,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IND_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') from IND_DIALYSIS_COND WHERE IND_END_DATE!='99991231' and CTL_NO = '004' ) WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(DIALYSIS_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$') GROUP BY PATID,DIALYSIS_DATE ),PAT_CTR_NEW AS ( SELECT c.PATID,PRESCALE_U, PRESCALE_L, EXAM_DATE, CASE ORDER_CLASS WHEN '0' THEN '1' WHEN '1' THEN '2' WHEN '2' THEN '3' END ORDER_CLASS, STATURE, CTR_WEIGHT, CTR, INDICATOR_CD, INDICATOR_CD AS UPDATE_STAFF_CD, DW, TARGET_WEIGHT, BREAST_DIA, CHEST_DIA,MEMO, IND_START_DATE, '1' AS FLAG, '0' AS facility_cd FROM (SELECT PATID,PRESCALE_U,PRESCALE_L FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO b WHERE a.PATID = b.PATID AND a.REG_DATE<b.REG_DATE)) c INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PAT_CTR d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PAT_CTR e WHERE d.PATID = e.PATID AND d.REG_DATE = e.REG_DATE AND d.UP_DATE<e.UP_DATE ) and d.DEL_FLG = '0' ) f ON ( c.PATID = f.PATID )), COND_MAXUPD_TMP AS ( SELECT cond.PATID, PLURAL, CTL_NO, MAX( UP_DATE ) MAX_UP_DATE, DIALYSIS_DATE FROM IND_DIALYSIS_COND cond INNER JOIN DIALYSIS_DATE_list dates on dates.PATID=cond.PATID and dates.DIALYSIS_DATE BETWEEN cond.IND_START_DATE AND cond.IND_END_DATE WHERE CTL_NO = '004' GROUP BY cond.PATID, PLURAL, CTL_NO, DIALYSIS_DATE ), COND_TMP AS ( SELECT COND.PATID, COND.PLURAL, MAX( COND.IND_NO ) MAX_IND_NO, COND.CTL_NO, CT.MAX_UP_DATE, CT.DIALYSIS_DATE FROM IND_DIALYSIS_COND COND, COND_MAXUPD_TMP CT WHERE COND.PATID = CT.PATID AND COND.PLURAL = CT.PLURAL AND COND.CTL_NO = CT.CTL_NO AND COND.UP_DATE = CT.MAX_UP_DATE AND CT.DIALYSIS_DATE BETWEEN COND.IND_START_DATE AND COND.IND_END_DATE AND COND.CTL_NO='004' GROUP BY COND.PATID, COND.PLURAL, COND.CTL_NO, CT.MAX_UP_DATE, CT.DIALYSIS_DATE ), IND_DEVELOP_COND_NEW AS ( SELECT COND.PATID, null AS PRESCALE_U, null AS PRESCALE_L, case when COND.UP_DATE >d.UP_DATE then TO_DATE(CT.DIALYSIS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + INTERVAL '1' DAY - INTERVAL '1' SECOND else TO_DATE(CT.DIALYSIS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') end as EXAM_DATE, '1' AS ORDER_CLASS, null AS STATURE, null AS CTR_WEIGHT, null AS CTR, COND.INDICATOR_CD, COND.UPDATE_STAFF_CD, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(COND.VALUE_1W1N, 'FM9999990.00' ))AS DW, null AS TARGET_WEIGHT, null AS BREAST_DIA, null AS CHEST_DIA, '' AS MEMO, '' AS IND_START_DATE, '2' AS FLAG, '0' AS facility_cd FROM IND_DIALYSIS_COND COND INNER JOIN COND_TMP CT ON COND.PATID = CT.PATID AND COND.PLURAL = CT.PLURAL AND COND.CTL_NO = CT.CTL_NO AND COND.UP_DATE = CT.MAX_UP_DATE AND COND.IND_NO = CT.MAX_IND_NO left join (SELECT PATID, TRUNC(EXAM_DATE) AS EXAM_DAY, MAX(UP_DATE) AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_CTR GROUP BY PATID, TRUNC(EXAM_DATE)) d on d.PATID=COND.PATID and d.EXAM_DAY=TO_DATE(CT.DIALYSIS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE COND.DEL_FLG='0' AND COND.CTL_NO='004' ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID,EXAM_DATE) AS CTL_NO, a.* FROM (SELECT * FROM PAT_CTR_NEW UNION SELECT * FROM IND_DEVELOP_COND_NEW WHERE DW IS NOT NULL) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,EXAM_DATE

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=w1.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) SELECT a.PATID,a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD as CODE,case when a.AUTO_CALC!='0' then '1' else nvl(m.ADD_FLG ,0) end as ADD_FLG ,nvl(m.UP_DATE,a.UP_DATE) as UP_DATE FROM ( SELECT a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD,a.UP_DATE, PATID, b.DISP_ORDER ,AUTO_CALC FROM MST_RECEIPT_MEMO a INNER JOIN MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_SUB_NEW b ON ( a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD = b.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD ) LEFT JOIN MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS c ON c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL b ON 1 = 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_RECEIPT_MEMO c WHERE a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD = c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD AND a.UP_DATE < c.UP_DATE ) AND b.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' AND a.DEL_FLG = 0 AND b.DISP_FLG = 1 ) a LEFT JOIN PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO m ON a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD = m.CODE AND DIVISION = '1' AND a.PATID = m.PATID WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO b WHERE m.PATID = b.PATID AND m.DIVISION = b.DIVISION AND m.CODE = b.CODE AND m.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE ) ORDER BY a.PATID, a.DISP_ORDER nulls last, a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD

SELECT v.PATID ,CASE WHEN DAY_OF_WEEK = 0 THEN 7 ELSE DAY_OF_WEEK END AS DAY_OF_WEEK ,MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,1,REVISE_NAME)) AS REVISE_NAME_1 ,nvl(MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,1,REVISE_WEIGHT)),0) AS REVISE_WEIGHT_1 ,MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,2,REVISE_NAME)) AS REVISE_NAME_2 ,nvl(MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,2,REVISE_WEIGHT)),0) AS REVISE_WEIGHT_2 ,MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,3,REVISE_NAME)) AS REVISE_NAME_3 ,nvl(MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,3,REVISE_WEIGHT)),0) AS REVISE_WEIGHT_3 ,MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,4,REVISE_NAME)) AS REVISE_NAME_4 ,nvl(MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,4,REVISE_WEIGHT)),0) AS REVISE_WEIGHT_4 ,MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,5,REVISE_NAME)) AS REVISE_NAME_5 ,nvl(MAX(DECODE(CTL_NO,5,REVISE_WEIGHT)),0) AS REVISE_WEIGHT_5 from V_PAT_REVISE_OFFWATER v INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=v.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' WHERE day_of_week <> -1 {sqlForSync} GROUP BY v.PATID,DAY_OF_WEEK ORDER BY v.PATID,DAY_OF_WEEK

WITH TABOO_GROUP AS( SELECT '0' as TABOO_CLASS, a.TABOO_GROUP_CD, a.TABOO_GROUP_NAME FROM MST_TABOO_GROUP a INNER JOIN MST_TABOO_GROUP_SUB_NEW b ON ( a.TABOO_GROUP_CD = b.TABOO_GROUP_CD AND a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE ) WHERE b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ,MEDICINE_GROUP AS( SELECT '1' as TABOO_CLASS, a.MEDICINE_CD, a.MEDICINE_NAME FROM MST_MEDICINE a inner join MST_MEDICINE_SUB_NEW b on(a.MEDICINE_CD=b.MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ,SET_MEDI_NAME AS( select '2' as TABOO_CLASS, a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, a.SET_MEDICINE_NAME from MST_SET_MEDI_NAME a inner join MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_SUB_NEW b on(a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = b.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) ), MST_EQUIMENT_NAME AS( SELECT '3' as TABOO_CLASS,EQUIP_CD,EQUIP_NAME FROM MST_EQUIPMENT A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM MST_EQUIPMENT B WHERE A.EQUIP_CD = B.EQUIP_CD AND A.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE ) ), MST_DIALYZER_NAME AS( SELECT '4' as TABOO_CLASS, a.DIALYZER_CD,a.MODEL_NUMBER
FROM MST_DIALYZER a inner join MST_DIALYZER_SUB_NEW b on(a.DIALYZER_CD=b.DIALYZER_CD and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) SELECT a.PATID, CTL_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY DISP_NO) AS DISP_NO, TABOO, decode(a.TABOO_CLASS,NULL,'5',a.TABOO_CLASS) as TABOO_CLASS, TABOO_CD, 1 AS TABOO_ALLERGY_CLASS ,case a .TABOO_CLASS when '0' then case when a.TABOO=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_GROUP_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '1' then case when a.TABOO=MEDICINE_GROUP.MEDICINE_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '2' then case when a.TABOO=SET_MEDI_NAME.SET_MEDICINE_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '3' then case when a.TABOO=MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.EQUIP_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '4' then case when a.TABOO=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.MODEL_NUMBER then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end else MEMO end as MEMO FROM PAT_TABOO a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join TABOO_GROUP on a.TABOO_CD=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_GROUP_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_CLASS left join MEDICINE_GROUP on a.TABOO_CD=MEDICINE_GROUP.MEDICINE_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=MEDICINE_GROUP.TABOO_CLASS left join SET_MEDI_NAME on a.TABOO_CD=SET_MEDI_NAME.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=SET_MEDI_NAME.TABOO_CLASS left join MST_EQUIMENT_NAME on a.TABOO_CD = MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.EQUIP_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS = MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.TABOO_CLASS left join MST_DIALYZER_NAME on a.TABOO_CD=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.DIALYZER_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.TABOO_CLASS WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_TABOO b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) AND DEL_FLG = '0' {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,CTL_NO,DISP_NO

child.sqlForTool: select GROUP_CD,ITEM_CD,row_number ( ) over ( partition BY a.GROUP_CD ORDER BY a.PRIORITY ) AS PRIORITY, title,11 AS width,'2' as vital_monitor_class,key_name from( select GROUP_CD, c.FNSI_ITEM_CD AS key_name, c.FNSI_DATA_CLASS as ITEM_CD, a.PRIORITY,b.ITEM_NAME as TITLE,11 AS width,'2' as VITAL_MONITOR_CLASS from SYS_MONI_ITEM a left join MST_JKMONITOR_ITEM b on a.ITEM_CD = b.ITEM_CD left join SYNC_MON_DATA_MAP c on c.FNW_ITEM_CD = a.ITEM_CD and c.TABLE_NAME = 'MST_JKMONITOR_ITEM') a where a.ITEM_CD is not null and a.ITEM_CD!=3 order by a.GROUP_CD,a.PRIORITY,ITEM_CD

SELECT * FROM (select GROUP_CD FROM SYS_MONI_ITEM_GROUP ) a JOIN (select FNSI_DATA_CLASS as DATA_CLASS,a.ITEM_CD,a.PRIORITY,c.MON_DATA_NAME title,11 as width,'mni_monitor' as table_name,'monitor_data' as column_name,'2' as vital_monitor_class, 'A'||a.ITEM_CD AS KEY_NAME from SYS_MCN_ITEM a left join (select GROUP_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD ORDER BY DISP_ORDER asc) as RN from SYS_MCN_ITEM_GROUP where DEVICE_TYPE_CD=1 and SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') b on a.GROUP_CD=b.GROUP_CD left join (select c.* from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN c where not exists(select * from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN b where c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and c.MON_NO=b.MON_NO AND c.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE)) c on c.MON_NO = a.ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN SYNC_MON_DATA_MAP d ON d.FNW_ITEM_CD = a.ITEM_CD AND d.TABLE_NAME = 'DAB_VIEW_ITEMS' and d.KIND_CD='1' where a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = '1' and b.RN=1 and c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = '1' ) b on 1=1 ORDER BY GROUP_CD,PRIORITY

SELECT * FROM (select GROUP_CD FROM SYS_MONI_ITEM_GROUP ) a JOIN (select FNSI_DATA_CLASS as data_class, a.ITEM_CD, a.PRIORITY, c.MON_DATA_NAME title,11 as width,'mni_monitor' as table_name,'monitor_data' as column_name,'2' as vital_monitor_class, 'D'||a.ITEM_CD AS KEY_NAME from SYS_MCN_ITEM a left join (select GROUP_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD ORDER BY DISP_ORDER asc) as RN from SYS_MCN_ITEM_GROUP where DEVICE_TYPE_CD=2 and SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') b on a.GROUP_CD=b.GROUP_CD left join (select c.* from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN c where not exists(select * from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN b where c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and c.MON_NO=b.MON_NO AND c.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE)) c on c.MON_NO = a.ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN SYNC_MON_DATA_MAP d ON d.FNW_ITEM_CD = a.ITEM_CD AND d.TABLE_NAME = 'DAD_VIEW_ITEMS' and d.KIND_CD='2' where a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = '2' and c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=2 and b.RN=1 ) b on 1=1 ORDER BY GROUP_CD,PRIORITY

SELECT * FROM (select GROUP_CD FROM SYS_MONI_ITEM_GROUP ) a JOIN (select FNSI_DATA_CLASS as data_class, a.ITEM_CD, a.PRIORITY, c.MON_DATA_NAME title,11 as width,'mni_monitor' as table_name,'monitor_data' as column_name,'2' as vital_monitor_class, 'R'||a.ITEM_CD AS KEY_NAME from SYS_MCN_ITEM a left join (select GROUP_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD ORDER BY DISP_ORDER asc) as RN from SYS_MCN_ITEM_GROUP where DEVICE_TYPE_CD=3 and SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') b on a.GROUP_CD=b.GROUP_CD left join (select c.* from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN c where not exists(select * from MST_MONITOR_ITEM_MCN b where c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and c.MON_NO=b.MON_NO AND c.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE)) c on c.MON_NO = a.ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN SYNC_MON_DATA_MAP d ON d.FNW_ITEM_CD = a.ITEM_CD AND d.TABLE_NAME = 'DRO_VIEW_ITEMS' and d.KIND_CD='3' where a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = '3' and c.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=3 and b.RN=1 ) b on 1=1 ORDER BY GROUP_CD,PRIORITY

tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select * from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over(partition BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, VERSION order by UP_DATE desc) rn , key,DISP_FLG, DEVICE_TYPE_CD, a.VERSION, disp_machine_name, machine_name, com_format_cd,UP_DATE from ( SELECT DISTINCT a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD || a.VERSION as key, case when a.DEL_FLG = '0' then '1' else '0' end AS DISP_FLG, case a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD when '001' then '079' when '002' then '079' when '003' then '075' when '004' then '075' when '005' then '077' when '006' then '077' when '007' then '080' when '008' then '080' when '009' then '076' when '010' then '076' when '011' then '074' when '012' then '074' when '013' then '073' when '014' then '073' when '015' then '087' when '016' then '083' when '017' then '088' when '018' then '084' when '019' then '082' when '020' then '081' when '026' then '071' when '027' then '072' when '029' then '071' when '030' then '072' when '031' then '069' when '032' then '070' end DEVICE_TYPE_CD, a.VERSION,REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','')||' '||a.VERSION||' ～ ' as disp_machine_name, regexp_replace(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') AS machine_name, MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD as com_format_cd, a.UP_DATE FROM mst_selfdiag_alermset a LEFT JOIN mst_device_type ON mst_device_type.device_type_cd = a.device_type_cd where NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM mst_selfdiag_alermset B WHERE A.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = B.DEVICE_TYPE_CD AND A.VERSION = B.VERSION AND A.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO = B.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO AND A.SERIES_CD = B.SERIES_CD AND A.UP_DATE < B.UP_DATE ) and a.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' AND ((REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCS-200Si' AND (mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'P' OR mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'M')) OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBB-200Si' AND (mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'Q' OR mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'N')) OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCS-100NX' AND (mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'P' OR mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'M')) OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBB-100NX' AND (mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'Q' OR mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'N')) OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCG-03' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'M') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBG-03' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'N') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCS-73' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'I') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCS-27' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'I') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DCS-28' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'I') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'ADC-27' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'I') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBB-73' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'J') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBB-27' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'J') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'DBB-28' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'J') OR (REGEXP_REPLACE(MST_DEVICE_TYPE.DEVICE_TYPE_NAME,'[\(].*[\)]','') = 'ADB-27' AND mst_device_type.DEV_COM_FORMAT_CD = 'J')) {2}) a )b where b.RN<=1 ORDER BY device_type_cd

child.sqlForTool:
select a.* ,b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD from (select distinct DEVICE_TYPE_CD || VERSION as key, '' as VERSION_UP, VERSION from MST_SELFDIAG_ALERMSET a where a.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) a left join (select distinct DEVICE_TYPE_CD || VERSION as key, case DEVICE_TYPE_CD when '001' then '079' when '002' then '079' when '003' then '075' when '004' then '075' when '005' then '077' when '006' then '077' when '007' then '080' when '008' then '080' when '009' then '076' when '010' then '076' when '011' then '074' when '012' then '074' when '013' then '073' when '014' then '073' when '015' then '087' when '016' then '083' when '017' then '088' when '018' then '084' when '019' then '082' when '020' then '081' when '026' then '071' when '027' then '072' when '029' then '071' when '030' then '072' when '031' then '069' when '032' then '070' else '999' end DEVICE_TYPE_CD from MST_SELFDIAG_ALERMSET a where a.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) b
on a.KEY=b.KEY where b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD != '999' order by b.DEVICE_TYPE_CD,a.VERSION

select a.DEVICE_TYPE_CD || a.VERSION as key, case a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO when 4 then 47 when 6 then 43 when 7 then 44 when 8 then 48 when 9 then 46 when 10 then 45 when 11 then 49 when 15 then 53 when 16 then 54 when 20 then 65 when 21 then 63 when 22 then 64 when 32 then 58 else a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO end SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO, ON_FLG, case a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO when 32 then case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '0' or b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ROUND(500 ＋ (500 * ALARM_POINT / 100), 3) end else case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '0' or b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ALARM_POINT end end failure_up, case a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO when 32 then case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '1' then ROUND(500 ＋ (500 * ALARM_POINT / 100), 3) when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ROUND((500 ＋ (500 * ALARM_POINT * (-1) / 100)), 3) end else case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '1' then ALARM_POINT when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ALARM_POINT * (-1) end end failure_low, case a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO when 32 then case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '0' or b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ROUND(500 ＋ (500 * WARNING_POINT / 100), 3) end else case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '0' or b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then WARNING_POINT end end caution_up, case a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO when 32 then case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '1' then ROUND(500 ＋ (500 * WARNING_POINT / 100), 3) when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then ROUND((500 ＋ (500 * WARNING_POINT * (-1) / 100)), 3) end else case when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '1' then WARNING_POINT when b.ERROR_UP_OR_DOWN = '2' then WARNING_POINT * (-1) end end caution_low from MST_SELFDIAG_ALERMSET a left join MST_SELFDIAG_LISTITEM b on a.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO = b.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM MST_SELFDIAG_ALERMSET B WHERE A.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=B.DEVICE_TYPE_CD and A.VERSION=B.VERSION and A.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO=B.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO AND A.SERIES_CD=B.SERIES_CD AND A.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE) AND A.SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO IN (4,6,7,8,9,10,11,15,16,20,21,22,32) AND a.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ORDER BY key, SELFDIAG_ITEM_NO

with SYS_MONI_GRAPH_LINE_NOMAL as( select a.GRAPH_NO,MON_KIND_CD, max(decode(Y_AXIS,1,MON_DATA_NO)) as left_data_index, max(decode(Y_AXIS,2,MON_DATA_NO)) as right_data_index, tableInfo.name: 患者グループ詳細マスタ
tableInfo.sqlForTool: {1} select a.* from ( WITH SYS_CUSTOM_KEY_NORMAL AS ( select a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD as PAT_GROUP_CD, a.CUSTOM_KEY_NAME, a.UP_DATE, a.DEL_FLG, b.DISP_FLG from SYS_CUSTOM_KEY a left join SYS_CUSTOM_KEY_DISP b on(a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD=b.CUSTOM_KEY_CD) where a.DEL_FLG = '0' and b.DISP_FLG = '1'and SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ), PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS ( SELECT w1.* FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON ( w2.PAT_STATUS = '0' AND w1.PATID = w2.PATID) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) S ON S.PATID=w1.PATID AND S.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) SELECT TO_CHAR( a.PAT_GROUP_CD ) AS PAT_GROUP_CD, a.CUSTOM_KEY_NAME AS PAT_GROUP_NAME, b.PATID AS PKEY, b.UP_DATE FROM SYS_CUSTOM_KEY_NORMAL a, SYS_PAT_CUSTOM_KEY b INNER JOIN ( SELECT w1.PATID FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON ( w2.PAT_STATUS = '0' AND w1.PATID = w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE = w2.PAT_REG_DATE ) ) d ON b.PATID = d.PATID WHERE a.PAT_GROUP_CD = b.CUSTOM_KEY_CD AND a.PAT_GROUP_CD IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.PAT_GROUP_CD, a.PAT_GROUP_NAME, c.PATID AS PKEY, c.REG_DATE as UP_DATE FROM MST_PAT_GROUP a INNER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL c ON a.PAT_GROUP_CD = c.PAT_GROUP_CD WHERE c.PAT_GROUP_CD IS NOT NULL and a.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) S ON S.PATID=a.PKEY AND S.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where 1=1 {2} order by PKEY,a.UP_DATE,PAT_GROUP_CD

WITH SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST as( SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' ) ) select * from (SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'1'||TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME,a.UP_DATE FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'2'||TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME,a.UP_DATE FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'3'||TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO2 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO2 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME,a.UP_DATE FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO ||'4'||TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS KEY, a.DISABILITY_NO, a.PUB_INSU_NO1 as INSU_PUB_NO , a.PUB_INSU_RECNO1 as insu_pub_pat_no, '' as INSU_PUB_NAME,a.UP_DATE FROM PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY_LIST s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) where 1=1 {sqlForSync} order BY KEY

WITH PAT_INSURANCE_LIST as( SELECT a.PATID,a.CTL_NO ,TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as UP_DATE from PAT_INSURANCE a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) select KEY,'' AS INSU_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB1_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB2_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB3_CD, '' AS INSU_PUB4_CD from (SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'1'||a.UP_DATE AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'2'||a.UP_DATE AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO||'3'||a.UP_DATE AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a union all SELECT a.PATID||a.CTL_NO ||'4'||a.UP_DATE AS KEY FROM PAT_INSURANCE_LIST a ) where 1=1 {sqlForSync} order BY KEY

AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE )) ,PATID_UP_DATE_MAX AS ( SELECT b.PATID,max(b.UP_DATE) as REG_DATE FROM ( SELECT PATID, REG_DATE as UP_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO UNION ALL SELECT PDS.PATID, PDS.REG_DATE AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_DEVICE_SET PDS WHERE PDS.DAY_OF_WEEK = -1 UNION ALL SELECT PFC.PATID,PFC.UP_DATE FROM PAT_FREE_COMMENT PFC UNION ALL SELECT PINF.PATID,PINF.UP_DATE FROM MST_WHEELCHAIR MW WHERE MW.PAT_FLG = '1' ) b GROUP BY b.PATID ), PATID_UP_DATE AS ( SELECT b.PATID, b.UP_DATE as REG_DATE FROM ( SELECT PATID, REG_DATE as UP_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO UNION ALL SELECT PDS.PATID, PDS.REG_DATE AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_DEVICE_SET PDS WHERE PDS.DAY_OF_WEEK = -1 UNION ALL SELECT PFC.PATID,PFC.UP_DATE FROM PAT_FREE_COMMENT PFC UNION ALL SELECT PINF.PATID,PINF.UP_DATE FROM PAT_INFECT PINF UNION ALL SELECT PRM.PATID, PRM.UP_DATE FROM PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO PRM UNION ALL SELECT PRO.PATID, PRO.UP_DATE FROM PAT_REVISE_OFFWATER PRO UNION ALL SELECT PRT.PATID, PRT.UP_DATE FROM PAT_REVISE_TARE PRT UNION ALL SELECT PT.PATID, PT.UP_DATE FROM PAT_TABOO PT UNION ALL SELECT SPCY.PATID, SPCY.UP_DATE FROM SYS_PAT_CUSTOM_KEY SPCY UNION ALL SELECT MW.PATID, MW.UP_DATE FROM MST_WHEELCHAIR MW WHERE MW.PAT_FLG = '1' UNION ALL SELECT b.PATID , a.UP_DATE FROM MST_RECEIPT_MEMO a JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NOW b ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN PATID_UP_DATE_MAX p on p.PATID=b.PATID and a.UP_DATE>p.REG_DATE {3} ) b GROUP BY b.PATID, b.UP_DATE ),WHEEL_INFO AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD,WHEELCHAIR_NAME,WHEELCHAIR_WEIGHT, UP_DATE AS START_DATE, NVL( LEAD(UP_DATE) OVER ( PARTITION BY HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD ORDER BY UP_DATE ), SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1' DAY ) AS END_DATE, PAT_FLG FROM MST_WHEELCHAIR WHERE DEL_FLG = '0' ) WHERE PAT_FLG = '0' ),PAT_WHEELCHAIR_LIST as ( select * from (SELECT HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD, PATID, PAT_FLG, UP_DATE AS START_TIME, nvl(LEAD(UP_DATE) OVER ( PARTITION BY HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD ORDER BY UP_DATE ) ,SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1' DAY)AS END_TIME FROM MST_WHEELCHAIR WHERE DEL_FLG = '0' ) where PATID is not null ) {1} select DISTINCT a.DISEASE_NAME as DIALYSIS_UNDERLYING_DISEASE, a.GROUP_DATE, a.REG_DATE, a.PATID, a.FACILITY_CD, a.IS_IMPLANT, a.SCH_EXT_END_DATE, a.PLAN_INOUT_STATE_CD, a.PLAN_INOUT_STATE_DATE, a.BLOOD_SUGER, case when d.HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD is null then '0' else case when p.PATID is null then '1' else '0' end end HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD, a.INFECT, a.DIABETES, a.SAME_FLG, a.DEL_FLG, a.PAT_GROUP_CD, (CASE a.DIE_FLG WHEN '1' THEN '11' ELSE (CASE a.INOUT_STATE_CD WHEN '0' THEN '0' WHEN '1' THEN '0' WHEN '2' THEN '3' WHEN '4' THEN '3' WHEN '5' THEN '7' WHEN '6' THEN '8' WHEN '7' THEN '9' ELSE '10' END) END) AS INOUT_STATE_CD, '' as PAT_MEMO_INFO ,'[]' as IMPLANT_INFO,'[]' AS ACCEPTANCE_STATUS_INFO, case when p.PATID is null then d.HOSP_WHEELCHAIR_CD else null end AS WHEEL_CHAIR_CD, case when p.PATID is null then d.WHEELCHAIR_NAME else null end AS WHEEL_CHAIR_NAME, case when p.PATID is null then d.WHEELCHAIR_WEIGHT else null end AS WHEEL_CHAIR_WEIGHT from ( SELECT p.DISEASE_NAME, p.REG_DATE AS GROUP_DATE, c.REG_DATE, p.PATID, FACILITY_CD, IS_IMPLANT, SCH_EXT_END_DATE, PLAN_INOUT_STATE_CD, PLAN_INOUT_STATE_DATE, BLOOD_SUGER, INFECT, DIABETES, SAME_FLG, DEL_FLG, PAT_GROUP_CD, INOUT_STATE_CD, DIE_FLG FROM PATID_UP_DATE c INNER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL p ON c.PATID = p.PATID AND BLOOD_SUGER, INFECT, DIABETES, SAME_FLG, DEL_FLG, PAT_GROUP_CD, INOUT_STATE_CD, DIE_FLG FROM PATID_UP_DATE c INNER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL p ON c.PATID = p.PATID AND ( c.REG_DATE < p.prev_reg_date AND c.REG_DATE > p.REG_DATE ) ) a LEFT JOIN PAT_REVISE_TARE b ON b.PATID = a.PATID AND b.DAY_OF_WEEK = -1 AND b.CTL_NO = 6 AND b.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAT_REVISE_TARE a2 WHERE a2.PATID = b.PATID AND a2.DAY_OF_WEEK = -1 AND a2.CTL_NO = 6 AND a2.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE AND a2.UP_DATE > b.UP_DATE ) LEFT JOIN WHEEL_INFO d on a.REG_DATE>= d.START_DATE and a.REG_DATE < {sqlForSync} {2} ORDER BY a.PATID,a.REG_DATE

child.sqlForTool: SELECT a.PATID, STAFF_CD, IS_MAIN, IS_CHARGE, REG_DATE, ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID ) AS CTL_NO, disp_order, IS_PUNCTURE, STAFF_NAME FROM ( SELECT PATID, DOCTOR_CD1 AS STAFF_CD, '1' AS IS_MAIN, '0' AS IS_CHARGE, REG_DATE, 1 AS disp_order, '0' AS IS_PUNCTURE, b.STAFF_NAME FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a LEFT JOIN MST_STAFF b ON b.STAFF_CD = a.DOCTOR_CD1 WHERE DOCTOR_CD1 IS NOT NULL AND b.UP_DATE = ( SELECT MAX( UP_DATE ) FROM MST_STAFF b WHERE a.DOCTOR_CD1 = b.STAFF_CD AND b.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE ) UNION ALL SELECT PATID, DOCTOR_CD2 AS STAFF_CD, '1' AS IS_MAIN, '0' AS IS_CHARGE, REG_DATE, 2 AS disp_order, '0' AS IS_PUNCTURE, b.STAFF_NAME FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a LEFT JOIN MST_STAFF b ON b.STAFF_CD = a.DOCTOR_CD2 WHERE DOCTOR_CD2 IS NOT NULL AND b.UP_DATE = ( SELECT MAX( UP_DATE ) FROM MST_STAFF b WHERE a.DOCTOR_CD2 = b.STAFF_CD AND b.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE ) UNION ALL SELECT PATID, STAFF_CD1 AS STAFF_CD, '0' AS IS_MAIN, '1' AS IS_CHARGE, REG_DATE, 3 AS disp_order, '0' AS IS_PUNCTURE, b.STAFF_NAME FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a LEFT JOIN MST_STAFF b ON b.STAFF_CD = a.STAFF_CD1 WHERE STAFF_CD1 IS NOT NULL AND b.UP_DATE = ( SELECT MAX( UP_DATE ) FROM MST_STAFF b WHERE a.STAFF_CD1 = b.STAFF_CD AND b.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE ) UNION ALL SELECT PATID, STAFF_CD2 AS STAFF_CD, '0' AS IS_MAIN, '1' AS IS_CHARGE, REG_DATE, 4 AS disp_order, '0' AS IS_PUNCTURE, b.STAFF_NAME FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a LEFT JOIN MST_STAFF b ON b.STAFF_CD = a.STAFF_CD2 WHERE STAFF_CD2 IS NOT NULL AND b.UP_DATE = ( SELECT MAX( UP_DATE ) FROM MST_STAFF b WHERE a.STAFF_CD2 = b.STAFF_CD AND b.UP_DATE <= a.REG_DATE ) ) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,disp_order

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS ( SELECT w1.PATID,w1.MEMO,REG_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON ( w2.PAT_STATUS = '0' AND w1.PATID = w2.PATID ) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=w1.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) SELECT b.PATID , MEMO as CONTENT, '患者メモ' as TITLE, 1 as CTL_NO,REG_DATE as UP_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL b UNION ALL SELECT PATID , CONTENT, TITLE, CTL_NO+1 as CTL_NO,UP_DATE FROM PAT_FREE_COMMENT

SELECT a.PATID,a.INFECTION_CD,a.INFECT,EXAM_DATE,TO_CHAR(a.UP_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as UP_DATE,a.UP_DATE as REG_DATE,b.INFECTION_NAME,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.INFECTION_CD) as TO_DOCTOR FROM PAT_INFECT a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join MST_INFECTION b on a.INFECTION_CD=b.INFECTION_CD WHERE a.DEL_FLG ='0' AND b.UP_DATE = (SELECT MAX( UP_DATE ) FROM MST_INFECTION b WHERE a.INFECTION_CD = b.INFECTION_CD AND b.UP_DATE <= a.UP_DATE ) {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,INFECTION_CD

WITH MSTDATA AS ( SELECT a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD, a.RECEIPT_MEMO_NAME,a.DEL_FLG,b.DISP_ORDER, CASE WHEN c.AUTO_CALC = '0' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS AUTO_CALC, CASE WHEN a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = '006' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS KIND, a.UP_DATE, NVL( LEAD ( a.UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD ORDER BY a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD, a.UP_DATE ASC ), DECODE( a.DEL_FLG, '1', a.UP_DATE, SYSDATE ) ) AS END_DATE FROM MST_RECEIPT_MEMO a INNER JOIN MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_SUB_NEW b ON ( a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD = b.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD ) LEFT JOIN MST_RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS c ON c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD = a.RECEIPT_MEMO_CLASS_CD where b.DISP_FLG='1' ) ,BASE_DATA as ( select PATID, RECEIPT_MEMO_CD,RECEIPT_MEMO_NAME, AUTO_CALC ,KIND,UP_DATE,DEL_FLG,END_DATE,DISP_ORDER from MSTDATA, PAT_INDEX_INFO ) ,RECEIPT_MEMO_DATA AS ( SELECT PATID, UP_DATE, CODE, ADD_FLG FROM PAT_RECEIPT_MEMO WHERE DIVISION = '1' ) select c.PATID, nvl(a.UP_DATE,c.UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD as CODE, c.RECEIPT_MEMO_NAME as NAME,c.DEL_FLG,DISP_ORDER, case when c.AUTO_CALC='1' then '1' else nvl(a.ADD_FLG,0) end as ADD_FLG, c.KIND, null as LAST_DATE from BASE_DATA c INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on c.PATID=s.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join RECEIPT_MEMO_DATA a ON a.CODE = c.RECEIPT_MEMO_CD AND a.UP_DATE >= c.UP_DATE AND a.UP_DATE < c.END_DATE and a.PATID=c.PATID ORDER BY c.PATID, c.DISP_ORDER nulls last, RECEIPT_MEMO_CD
