SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' order by a.PATID,a.UP_DATE,DAY_OF_WEEK

WITH TABOO_GROUP AS( SELECT '0' as TABOO_CLASS, a.TABOO_GROUP_CD, a.TABOO_GROUP_NAME FROM MST_TABOO_GROUP a INNER JOIN MST_TABOO_GROUP_SUB_NEW b ON ( a.TABOO_GROUP_CD = b.TABOO_GROUP_CD AND a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE ) WHERE b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ,MEDICINE_GROUP AS( SELECT '1' as TABOO_CLASS, a.MEDICINE_CD, a.MEDICINE_NAME FROM MST_MEDICINE a inner join MST_MEDICINE_SUB_NEW b on(a.MEDICINE_CD=b.MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) ,SET_MEDI_NAME AS( select '2' as TABOO_CLASS, a.SET_MEDICINE_CD, a.SET_MEDICINE_NAME from MST_SET_MEDI_NAME a inner join MST_SET_MEDI_NAME_SUB_NEW b on(a.SET_MEDICINE_CD = b.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) ), MST_EQUIMENT_NAME AS( SELECT '3' as TABOO_CLASS,EQUIP_CD,EQUIP_NAME FROM MST_EQUIPMENT A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM MST_EQUIPMENT B WHERE A.EQUIP_CD = B.EQUIP_CD AND A.UP_DATE<B.UP_DATE ) ), MST_DIALYZER_NAME AS( SELECT '4' as TABOO_CLASS, a.DIALYZER_CD,a.MODEL_NUMBER
FROM MST_DIALYZER a inner join MST_DIALYZER_SUB_NEW b on(a.DIALYZER_CD=b.DIALYZER_CD and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}' ) SELECT a.PATID, CTL_NO, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY DISP_NO) AS DISP_NO, TABOO, decode(a.TABOO_CLASS,NULL,'5',a.TABOO_CLASS) as TABOO_CLASS, TABOO_CD, 1 AS TABOO_ALLERGY_CLASS ,case a .TABOO_CLASS when '0' then case when a.TABOO=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_GROUP_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '1' then case when a.TABOO=MEDICINE_GROUP.MEDICINE_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '2' then case when a.TABOO=SET_MEDI_NAME.SET_MEDICINE_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '3' then case when a.TABOO=MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.EQUIP_NAME then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end when '4' then case when a.TABOO=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.MODEL_NUMBER then MEMO else case when MEMO is null then TABOO else TABOO||CHR(10)||MEMO end end else MEMO end as MEMO, a.UP_DATE FROM PAT_TABOO a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join TABOO_GROUP on a.TABOO_CD=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_GROUP_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=TABOO_GROUP.TABOO_CLASS left join MEDICINE_GROUP on a.TABOO_CD=MEDICINE_GROUP.MEDICINE_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=MEDICINE_GROUP.TABOO_CLASS left join SET_MEDI_NAME on a.TABOO_CD=SET_MEDI_NAME.SET_MEDICINE_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=SET_MEDI_NAME.TABOO_CLASS left join MST_EQUIMENT_NAME on a.TABOO_CD = MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.EQUIP_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS = MST_EQUIMENT_NAME.TABOO_CLASS left join MST_DIALYZER_NAME on a.TABOO_CD=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.DIALYZER_CD and a.TABOO_CLASS=MST_DIALYZER_NAME.TABOO_CLASS WHERE DEL_FLG = '0' {sqlForSync} ORDER BY WITH WARD_INFO AS ( SELECT WARD_CD, WARD_NAME, UP_DATE, IN_HOSPITAL_CD, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY WARD_CD ORDER BY WARD_CD ,UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM MST_WARD ORDER BY WARD_CD,UP_DATE ), COURSE_INFO AS ( SELECT COURSE_CD, COURSE_NAME, UP_DATE, IN_HOSPITAL_CD, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY COURSE_CD ORDER BY COURSE_CD ,UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM MST_COURSE ORDER BY COURSE_CD,UP_DATE ) SELECT a.PATID, a.WARD_CD as WARD_CD, null as FACILITY_CD, a.DIAL_COUNT as DIALYSIS_COUNT, null as MAIN_COURSE_CD, a.COURSE_CD as DIALYSIS_COURSE_CD, a.DIAL_COUNT as PAT_DIALYSIS_COUNT, null as PURIFICATION_COUNT, a.DIAL_START_DATE as DIALYSIS_START_DATE, a.START_DATE as HOSPITAL_START_DATE, null as OTHER_DIALYSIS_COUNT,REG_DATE,w.WARD_NAME,c.COURSE_NAME, null as FACILITY_NAME, null as MAIN_COURSE_NAME ,w.IN_HOSPITAL_CD as WARD_IN_HOSPITAL_CD_1, c.IN_HOSPITAL_CD as MAIN_IN_HOSPITAL_CD_1 FROM (SELECT w1.* FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=w1.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) a left join WARD_INFO w on a.WARD_CD=w.WARD_CD and a.REG_DATE>w.UP_DATE and a.REG_DATE<w.enddate left join COURSE_INFO c on c.COURSE_CD=a.COURSE_CD and a.REG_DATE>c.UP_DATE and a.REG_DATE<c.enddate {sqlForSync}

WITH GROUP_INFO AS ( SELECT a.PATID, a.REG_DATE, a.PAT_GROUP_CD, max( c.UP_DATE ) AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON ( w2.PAT_STATUS = '0' AND a.PATID = w2.PATID ) LEFT JOIN MST_PAT_GROUP c ON c.PAT_GROUP_CD = a.PAT_GROUP_CD and c.UP_DATE < a.REG_DATE WHERE a.PAT_GROUP_CD IS NOT NULL AND a.REG_DATE > c.UP_DATE GROUP BY a.PATID, a.REG_DATE, a.PAT_GROUP_CD ) SELECT a.PATID, NULL AS CTL_NO, a.REG_DATE AS UP_DATE, a.PAT_GROUP_CD, c.PAT_GROUP_NAME, NULL as DEL_DATE FROM GROUP_INFO a LEFT JOIN MST_PAT_GROUP c ON a.PAT_GROUP_CD = c.PAT_GROUP_CD AND a.UP_DATE = c.UP_DATE UNION ALL SELECT a.PATID, NULL AS CTL_NO, a.UP_DATE, TO_CHAR( a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD ) AS PAT_GROUP_CD, b.CUSTOM_KEY_NAME AS PAT_GROUP_NAME, CASE WHEN b.del_flg ='1' then b.up_date else to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd') end as DEL_DATE FROM SYS_PAT_CUSTOM_KEY a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' INNER JOIN SYS_CUSTOM_KEY b ON a.CUSTOM_KEY_CD = b.CUSTOM_KEY_CD {sqlForSync}

SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=A.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' AND A.CODE = C.CODE AND ( A.UP_DATE = C.UP_DATE OR ( A.UP_DATE > C.UP_DATE AND A.UP_DATE < C.END_DATE ) ) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_BASIC_DATA B WHERE A.PATID = B.PATID AND A.UP_DATE = B.UP_DATE AND A.CODE = B.CODE ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM BASE_BASIC_DATA ) SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.PATID, A.UP_DATE, NULL AS REG_DATE, A.CODE, A.DIAL_DIFF_COMMENT, A.IN_HOSPITAL_CD, A.IN_HOSPITAL_CD2, '0' AS IS_MAIN, '0' AS DIAL_DIFF FROM BASE_DATA A WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_BASIC_MEMO_DATA B WHERE A.PATID = B.PATID AND A.UP_DATE = B.UP_DATE AND A.CODE = B.CODE ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BASE_BASIC_MEMO_DATA ) A {sqlForSync}

tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.* FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID )) {1} select a.PATID,TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as REG_DATE from ( SELECT PATID, REG_DATE FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL UNION ALL SELECT PATID, UP_DATE as REG_DATE from PAT_MEDICAL_HST UNION ALL SELECT PATID, UP_DATE as REG_DATE from PAT_INOUT UNION ALL SELECT PATID, UP_DATE as REG_DATE from PAT_CTR UNION ALL SELECT PATID, UP_DATE as REG_DATE from IND_DIALYSIS_COND where CTL_NO = '004') a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' WHERE 1=1 {sqlForSync} {2} GROUP BY a.PATID, a.REG_DATE ORDER BY a.PATID,REG_DATE

child.sqlForTool: WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW AS( SELECT PATID,DIE_CD,DIE_DATE,BASE_DISEASE_CD FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a where NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO b where a.PATID = b.PATID and a.REG_DATE<b.REG_DATE) ), PAT_MEDICAL_HST_NEW AS ( SELECT PATID, CTL_NO, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_YEAR, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_MONTH, NULL AS DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_CD, DISEASE_DATE, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'yyyy') AS DISEASE_YEAR, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'mm') AS DISEASE_MONTH, TO_CHAR(DISEASE_DATE,'dd') AS DISEASE_DAY, MAIN_DISEASE, STATUS, RECOVER_DATE, NOTICE_FLG, NULL AS FACILITY_NAME_MEMO, case when DOCTOR_NAME is not null then '診断医：'||DOCTOR_NAME||CHR(13)||CHR(10) else '' end DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO, case when DOCTOR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE, DOCTOR_NAME as DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, MEMO,UP_DATE,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_MEDICAL_HST a), PAT_INOUT_DIE_NEW AS ( SELECT PATID, 0 AS CTL_NO, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'yyyy') AS DIAGNOSIS_YEAR, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'mm') AS DIAGNOSIS_MONTH, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'dd') AS DIAGNOSIS_DAY, NULL AS DISEASE_CD, NULL AS DISEASE_DATE, NULL AS DISEASE_YEAR, NULL AS DISEASE_MONTH, NULL AS DISEASE_DAY, NULL AS MAIN_DISEASE, '1' AS STATUS, NULL as RECOVER_DATE, NULL AS NOTICE_FLG, case when FACILITY_NAME is not null then '施設：'||FACILITY_NAME||' ' else '' end FACILITY_NAME_MEMO, case when DR_NAME is not null then '診断医：'||DR_NAME||' ' else '' end DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO, case when DR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE, DR_NAME as DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, NULL AS MEMO ,UP_DATE,FACILITY_NAME,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_INOUT a WHERE INOUT_CD='3' ),DIE_INFO AS( SELECT TRIM(DISEASE_CD)||'_1' AS DISEASE_CD, DISEASE_NAME, NULL AS IN_HOSPITAL_CD, UP_DATE, nvl(lead (UP_DATE, 1, NULL) over (PARTITION BY DISEASE_CD ORDER BY DISEASE_CD ,UP_DATE ASC), SYSDATE) AS enddate FROM MST_DIE UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(DISEASE_CD)||'_0' AS DISEASE_CD, DISEASE_NAME, IN_HOSPITAL_CD, UP_DATE, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY DISEASE_CD ORDER BY DISEASE_CD ,UP_DATE ASC), SYSDATE) AS enddate FROM MST_DISEASE ORDER BY DISEASE_CD,UP_DATE ),STAFF_INFO AS( SELECT STAFF_CD, staff_NAME, UP_DATE, nvl( lead ( UP_DATE, 1, NULL ) over ( PARTITION BY STAFF_CD ORDER BY STAFF_CD, UP_DATE ASC ), SYSDATE ) AS enddate FROM MST_STAFF ORDER BY staff_cd, UP_DATE ) SELECT '0' AS IS_CONFIRMATION_BIOPSY, '0' AS IS_DIAGNOSED, a.PATID, a.DIE_DATE, DECODE(CTL_NO,0,MAX(CTL_NO) OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID) + 1,CTL_NO) AS CTL_NO, a.DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,a.DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,a.DIAGNOSIS_DAY, a.DISEASE_YEAR,a.DISEASE_MONTH,a.DISEASE_DAY,a.DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,a.DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, a.IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS, TRIM(a.DISEASE_CD)||'_'||a.IS_DIE as DISEASE_CD,a.IS_DIE,a.DISEASE_DATE,a.MAIN_DISEASE, case a.STATUS when '0' then '3' when '1' then '10' when '2' then '8' when '3' then '1' else '' end STATUS, TO_CHAR(RECOVER_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as RECOVER_DATE,case when a.NOTICE_FLG='0' then '1' else '0' end as NOTICE_FLG ,a.MEMO,a.UP_DATE ,FACILITY_NAME,d.DISEASE_NAME,d.IN_HOSPITAL_CD,'0' AS COURSE_IS_FREE,'0' AS DIAGNOSIS_FACILITY_IS_FREE,DEL_FLG, row_number ( ) over ( PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY DISEASE_DATE DESC,a.UP_DATE DESC ) AS DISP_ORDER FROM ( SELECT a.PATID,null as DIE_DATE, CTL_NO, DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_YEAR,DISEASE_MONTH,DISEASE_DAY,DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, case when a.DISEASE_CD=b.BASE_DISEASE_CD then '1' else '0' end as IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS,DEL_FLG, DISEASE_CD,'0' AS IS_DIE,DISEASE_DATE,MAIN_DISEASE,STATUS,RECOVER_DATE,NOTICE_FLG,FACILITY_NAME_MEMO||DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO||MEMO AS MEMO,a.UP_DATE,null as FACILITY_NAME FROM PAT_MEDICAL_HST_NEW a LEFT OUTER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW b ON(a.PATID=b.PATID) UNION SELECT a.PATID,b.DIE_DATE,CTL_NO,DIAGNOSIS_YEAR,DIAGNOSIS_MONTH,DIAGNOSIS_DAY, DISEASE_YEAR,DISEASE_MONTH,DISEASE_DAY,DIAGNOSTICIAN_IS_FREE,DIAGNOSTICIAN_CD, NULL as IS_PRIMARY_ILLNESS,DEL_FLG, b.DIE_CD as DISEASE_CD,'1' AS IS_DIE,DISEASE_DATE,MAIN_DISEASE,STATUS,RECOVER_DATE,NOTICE_FLG,FACILITY_NAME_MEMO||DOCTOR_NAME_MEMO||MEMO AS MEMO,a.UP_DATE,FACILITY_NAME FROM PAT_INOUT_DIE_NEW a LEFT OUTER JOIN PAT_BASIC_INFO_NEW b ON(a.PATID=b.PATID) ) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' LEFT JOIN DIE_INFO d ON TRIM(a.DISEASE_CD)||'_'||a.IS_DIE =d.DISEASE_CD and a.UP_DATE>d.UP_DATE and a.UP_DATE<d.enddate {sqlForSync} ORDER BY PATID,CTL_NO

WITH PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.* FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO w1 INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO w2 ON(w2.PAT_STATUS='0' AND w1.PATID=w2.PATID AND w1.REG_DATE=w2.PAT_REG_DATE)) ,MST_FACILITY_NORMAL AS (SELECT w1.* FROM mst_facility w1 where NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mst_facility b WHERE w1.facility_cd=b.facility_cd AND w1.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE)) select a.*, DECODE(CTLNO,0,MAX(CTLNO) OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID) + 1,CTLNO) AS CTL_NO,'0' as COURSE_IS_FREE from ( SELECT a.PATID, case when c.PATID is null then CTL_NO else CTL_NO + 1 END as CTLNO, case when a.INOUT_CD = '2' then '3' when a.INOUT_CD = '3' then '11' when a.INOUT_CD = '4' then '3' when a.INOUT_CD = '5' then '7' when a.INOUT_CD = '6' then '8' when a.INOUT_CD = '7' then '9' when a.INOUT_CD = '1' then '2' end as INOUT_CD, FACILITY_CD AS FACILITY_CD, case when DR_NAME is not null then '担当医：'||DR_NAME||CHR(13)||CHR(10)||a.MEMO else a.MEMO end as MEMO, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as REG_DATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyy') as REG_DATE_YEAR, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'mm') as REG_DATE_MONTH, TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'dd') as REG_DATE_DAY, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '1', '3', '5', '6' ) then a.FACILITY_NAME else (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') end as FROM_FACILITY, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '2', '4' ,'7' ) then a.FACILITY_NAME else '' end as TO_FACILITY, case when a.FACILITY_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end as FACILITY_IS_FREE, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '2', '4', '7' ) then a.DR_NAME else '' end as TO_DOCTOR, case when a.INOUT_CD IN ( '1', '3', '5', '6' ) then a.DR_NAME else '' end as FROM_DOCTOR, case when a.DR_NAME is not null then '1' else '0' end as DOCTOR_IS_FREE, CASE WHEN a.INOUT_CD IN ('2', '4', '5', '6', '7') THEN '3' WHEN a.INOUT_CD = '3' THEN '2' ELSE CASE WHEN b.INOUT_FLG = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END END AS INOUT, 'true' as IN_OUT_CHECK, null as READONLY, (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') as FNSI_FACILITY_CD, '0' as PERIOD_START_INPUT_FREE, '0' as PERIOD_END_INPUT_FREE, null as PERIOD_END_DATE,UP_DATE,a.DEL_FLG FROM PAT_INOUT a left join PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL b on a.PATID = b.PATID left join PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL c ON a.PATID = c.PATID AND c.DIAL_START_DATE IS NOT NULL WHERE INOUT_CD IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL c WHERE c.PATID = a.PATID AND a.INOUT_CD = 1 AND c.DIAL_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND a.REG_DATE = c.DIAL_START_DATE ) union all select a.PATID,0 as CTLNO, '1' as INOUT_CD, INSTITUTION_CD as FACILITY_CD, '' as MEMO, a.DIAL_START_DATE as REG_DATE, a.DIAL_START_DATE as REG_DATE_DATE, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 1, 4) as REG_DATE_YEAR, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 5, 2) as REG_DATE_MONTH, SUBSTR(a.DIAL_START_DATE, 7, 2) as REG_DATE_DAY, b.FACILITY_NAME as FROM_FACILITY, '' as TO_FACILITY, '1' as FACILITY_IS_FREE, '' as TO_DOCTOR, '' as FROM_DOCTOR, '0' as DOCTOR_IS_FREE, CASE WHEN a.INOUT_FLG = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS INOUT, 'true' as IN_OUT_CHECK, null as READONLY, (SELECT FACILITY_CD FROM SYNC_FACILITY_CD WHERE SERIES_CD = '{SERIES_CD}') as FNSI_FACILITY_CD, '0' as PERIOD_START_INPUT_FREE, '0' as PERIOD_END_INPUT_FREE, null as PERIOD_END_DATE,REG_DATE as UP_DATE,a.DEL_FLG from PAT_BASIC_INFO_NORMAL a left join MST_FACILITY_NORMAL b on a.INSTITUTION_CD=b.FACILITY_CD where DIAL_START_DATE is not null) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' where 1=1 {sqlForSync} ORDER BY a.PATID,CTL_NO

WITH PAT_CTR_NEW AS ( SELECT REG_DATE, c.PATID,PRESCALE_U, PRESCALE_L, EXAM_DATE, CASE ORDER_CLASS WHEN '0' THEN '1' WHEN '1' THEN '2' WHEN '2' THEN '3' END ORDER_CLASS, STATURE, CTR_WEIGHT, CTR, trim(INDICATOR_CD) as INDICATOR_CD, trim(INDICATOR_CD) as UPDATE_STAFF_CD, DW, TARGET_WEIGHT, BREAST_DIA, CHEST_DIA,MEMO, IND_START_DATE, '1' AS FLAG, '0' AS facility_cd,f.UP_DATE,DEL_FLG FROM PAT_CTR f INNER JOIN (SELECT PATID,PRESCALE_U,PRESCALE_L FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PAT_BASIC_INFO b WHERE a.PATID = b.PATID AND a.REG_DATE<b.REG_DATE)) c ON ( c.PATID = f.PATID )), IND_DEVELOP_COND_NEW AS ( SELECT P.UP_DATE AS REG_DATE, p.PATID, null AS PRESCALE_U, null AS PRESCALE_L, p.up_date as EXAM_DATE, '1' AS ORDER_CLASS, null AS STATURE, null AS CTR_WEIGHT, null AS CTR, trim(p.INDICATOR_CD) as INDICATOR_CD, trim(p.UPDATE_STAFF_CD) as UPDATE_STAFF_CD, TO_NUMBER(NVL(p.VALUE_ALL,p.VALUE_1W1N))AS DW, null AS TARGET_WEIGHT, null AS BREAST_DIA, null AS CHEST_DIA, '' AS MEMO, '' AS IND_START_DATE, '2' AS FLAG, '0' AS facility_cd, p.up_date,DEL_FLG FROM ( select * from IND_DIALYSIS_COND t where CTL_NO = '004' and DEL_FLG = '0' and SPE_IND_FLG='0') p ) ,STAFF_INFO AS( SELECT trim(STAFF_CD) as STAFF_CD, STAFF_NAME, UP_DATE, nvl(lead (UP_DATE, 1, NULL) over (PARTITION BY STAFF_CD ORDER BY STAFF_CD ,UP_DATE ASC), SYSDATE) AS enddate FROM MST_STAFF ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.PATID ORDER BY a.PATID,a.UP_DATE) AS CTL_NO,a.*,s.STAFF_NAME,u.STAFF_NAME as UPDATE_STAFF_NAME FROM (SELECT * FROM PAT_CTR_NEW UNION SELECT * FROM IND_DEVELOP_COND_NEW WHERE DW IS NOT NULL) a INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) f on f.PATID=a.PATID and f.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join STAFF_INFO s on s.STAFF_CD=a.INDICATOR_CD and a.EXAM_DATE>s.UP_DATE and a.EXAM_DATE<s.enddate left join STAFF_INFO u on u.STAFF_CD=a.UPDATE_STAFF_CD and a.EXAM_DATE>u.UP_DATE and a.EXAM_DATE<u.enddate {sqlForSync}

tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH CALENDER as( select to_date('2000-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd') + rn as cal_date, to_date('2000-01-01 23:59:59','yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') + rn as cal_date_end from (select rownum-1 rn from dual connect by rownum <= (SELECT TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(sysdate, 1200))-TRUNC(to_date('2000-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')) FROM dual)) ), PAT_EVENT_NEW as ( select a.*, nvl(c.cal_date,a.start_date) as event_date from PAT_EVENT a left outer join CALENDER c on (a.END_DATE is not null and c.cal_date_end>=a.START_DATE and c.cal_date<=a.END_DATE) where not exists(select * from PAT_EVENT b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and c.pat_status='0') {sqlForSync} ), MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_1_NEW as( select a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, a.EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_1 from MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_1 a inner join MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_1_SUB_NEW b on(a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1=b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1 and a.UP_DATE=b.UP_DATE) where b.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and a.del_flg = '0' ), MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2_NEW as( select EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_2, VA_FLG from MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2 a inner join MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2_SUB_NEW b using(EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2,UP_DATE) where SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and del_flg = '0' ), MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_NEW as( select a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, b.EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_1, a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, a.EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_2, a.VA_FLG from MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2_NEW a left outer join MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_1_NEW b on(a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1=b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1) ) {1} select DESCRIPTION, a.PATID||','||a.CTL_NO as KEY, a.PATID, a.CTL_NO, '' as TEMPLATE_CD, '' as INPUT_PARAMS, case b.VA_FLG when '1' then 'VA' when '0' then 'VA以外' end as TEMPLATE_NAME, case b.VA_FLG when '1' then 1 else 0 end as USE_TYPE, '0'||a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2 as EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, b.EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_2, b.VA_FLG, b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, b.EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_1, TO_CHAR(event_date,'yyyymmdd') as FOLDER_NAME, NVL(ORG_FILE_NAME, 'null') as ORG_FILE_NAME, a.FILE_NAME as OLD_FULL_RV7_FILE_NAME, REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.FILE_NAME,'^.*[/\]') as RV7_FILE_PATH, REGEXP_REPLACE(a.FILE_NAME,'^.*[/\]','') as RV7_FILE_NAME, a.MAKE_DATE, a.MEMO, a.DEL_FLG, TO_CHAR(event_date,'yyyymmdd') as START_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.START_DATE,'hh24mi') as START_TIME, TO_CHAR(event_date,'yyyymmdd') as END_DATE, TO_CHAR(nvl(a.END_DATE,a.START_DATE),'hh24mi') as END_TIME, '1' as IS_NEWEST, '' as RESULT_PARAMS, '' as RESULT_VALUE_3, '' as RESULT_VALUE_4, '' as RESULT_VALUE_5, '' as RESULT_VALUE_6, '' as RESULT_VALUE_8, TO_CHAR( CAST( a.UP_DATE AS TIMESTAMP ) AT LOCAL, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM' ) AS UP_DATE, a.UP_DATE AS UP_TIME, null as BBS_SEQ_ID, NVL( c.IMAGE_COUNT , 0 ) AS IMAGE_COUNT,'1' as EVENT_STATUS FROM PAT_EVENT_NEW a inner join PAT_BASIC_INFO ba on ( a.PATID = ba.PATID and ba.DEL_FLG <> '1' and not exists(select * from PAT_BASIC_INFO bat where ba.PATID = bat.PATID and ba.REG_DATE < bat.REG_DATE)) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left outer join MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_NEW b on(a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2=b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2) left join (select a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, NVL(IMAGE_COUNT,0) as IMAGE_COUNT from MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2 a inner join MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_2_SUB_NEW b on (a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2 = b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2 and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) where SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' and del_flg = '0') c on c.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2=a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2 where 1=1 {2} order by PATID,CTL_NO

MST_EVENT_CATEGORY_NEW b on(a.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2=b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2) ), PHOTO_NAME_INFO as ( SELECT PATID || ',' || CTL_NO AS KEY,PHOTO_NAME,PHOTO_NO FROM PAT_EVENT_PHOTO_INFO unpivot ( PHOTO_NAME FOR PHOTO_NO IN ( PHOTO_NAME_01 AS 1, PHOTO_NAME_02 AS 2, PHOTO_NAME_03 AS 3, PHOTO_NAME_04 AS 4, PHOTO_NAME_05 AS 5, PHOTO_NAME_06 AS 6 ) ) ) {1} SELECT distinct PATID||','||CTL_NO as KEY, PATID, CTL_NO, PHOTO_NO, DESCRIPTION, '' as FILE_PATH, '1' as IS_SEND_VA, PHOTO_NAME as OLD_FULL_FILE_NAME, REGEXP_REPLACE(PHOTO_NAME,'^.*[/\]','') as FILE_NAME from PAT_EVENT_PHOTO_INFO a LEFT JOIN PHOTO_NAME_INFO b on a.PATID || ',' || a.CTL_NO=b.KEY order by PATID,CTL_NO,PHOTO_NO

'1'||b.EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2 as EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, '観察記録' as CATEGORY_NAME, -1 as EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, a.update_cnt, a.del_flg, 0 as ord_no, case when a.sh_flg='1' then '0' else '1' end as sh_flg, case when BBS_SEQ_ID is not null then case when ALL_STAFF_FLG='0' then d.disp_user_id end else ''''||TRIM(a.STAFF_CD)||'''' end as disp_user_id,ALL_STAFF_FLG,KIND_NAME, case when a.bbs_seq_id is not null then REPLACE(to_char(e.PUBLISH_START, 'yyyy-MM-dd/HH24:mi:ss'),'/','T')||'+09:00' else null end PUBLISH_START, case when a.bbs_seq_id is not null then REPLACE(to_char(e.PUBLISH_END, 'yyyy-MM-dd/HH24:mi:ss'),'/','T')||'+09:00' else null end PUBLISH_END, case when ALL_STAFF_FLG is not null then ALL_STAFF_FLG else '1' end as target,a.UP_DATE FROM pat_life_list a inner join PAT_BASIC_INFO ba on ( a.PATID = ba.PATID and ba.DEL_FLG <> '1' and not exists(select * from PAT_BASIC_INFO bat where ba.PATID = bat.PATID and ba.REG_DATE < bat.REG_DATE) AND NOT exists(select * from pat_life_list b where a.SEQ_ID = b.SEQ_ID and a.UP_DATE <b.UP_DATE)) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' left join (select to_number(a.KIND_ID) AS EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2,a.KIND_ID, KIND_NAME from MST_LLT_KIND a inner join MST_LLT_KIND_SUB_NEW b on (a.KIND_ID = b.KIND_ID and a.UP_DATE = b.UP_DATE) where SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}') b on b.KIND_ID=a.KIND_ID left join( select ALL_STAFF_FLG,SEQ_ID,TO_DATE(PUBLISH_START,'YYYY-MM-DD' )as PUBLISH_START,TO_DATE(PUBLISH_END,'YYYY-MM-DD' ) as PUBLISH_END from PAT_BBS_INF a where not exists(select * from PAT_BBS_INF b where a.SEQ_ID = b.SEQ_ID and a.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE)) e on e.SEQ_ID=a.bbs_seq_id left join (select SEQ_ID, TO_CHAR(rtrim(xmlagg(xmlparse(content ''''||TRIM(STAFF_CD) || ''',' wellformed) order by STAFF_CD).getclobval(),',' )) disp_user_id from PAT_BBS_STAFF group by SEQ_ID) d on d.SEQ_ID=a.bbs_seq_id WHERE 1=1 {2} {sqlForSync} order BY a.patid,a.reg_date,a.reg_time

tableInfo.name: 患者ADL情報
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH pm AS ( SELECT pa_in.PATID , pa_in.CATEGORY_CD , pa_in.CTL_NO , pa_in.VALUE , MAX(pa_in.REG_DATE) AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_ADL pa_in WHERE (pa_in.CATEGORY_CD = '218' AND pa_in.CTL_NO IN ('002', '003', '004', '005', '006')) OR (pa_in.CATEGORY_CD = '103' AND pa_in.CTL_NO IN ('002', '003', '004', '005', '006', '007', '008')) OR (pa_in.CATEGORY_CD = '109' AND pa_in.CTL_NO IN ('002', '003', '004', '005')) OR (pa_in.CATEGORY_CD = '110' AND pa_in.CTL_NO IN ('002', '003')) OR (pa_in.CATEGORY_CD = '113' AND pa_in.CTL_NO IN ('006', '007', '008', '009', '010', '011', '012', '013', '014')) GROUP BY pa_in.PATID , pa_in.CATEGORY_CD , pa_in.CTL_NO , pa_in.VALUE ) , PAT_ADL_TEMP AS ( SELECT pao.PATID , pao.CATEGORY_CD , CASE substr(pao.CATEGORY_CD, 0, 1) WHEN '1' THEN '心身状況' WHEN '2' THEN 'ADL' END AS CTL_CTG , pao.CTL_NO , pao.REG_DATE AS UP_DATE , LISTAGG(RAWTOHEX(pao.VALUE_STR), ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pao.CTL_NO) AS VALUE_STRS FROM PAT_ADL pao INNER JOIN ( SELECT pa.PATID , pa.CATEGORY_CD , pa.CTL_NO , MAX(pa.REG_DATE) AS UP_DATE FROM PAT_ADL pa WHERE pa.CATEGORY_CD NOT IN ('218','103','109','110','113') OR (pa.CATEGORY_CD = '218' AND pa.CTL_NO NOT IN ('002','003','004','005','006')) OR (pa.CATEGORY_CD = '103' AND pa.CTL_NO NOT IN ('002','003','004','005','006','007','008')) OR (pa.CATEGORY_CD = '109' AND pa.CTL_NO NOT IN ('002','003','004','005')) OR (pa.CATEGORY_CD = '110' AND pa.CTL_NO NOT IN ('002','003')) OR (pa.CATEGORY_CD = '113' AND pa.CTL_NO NOT IN ('006','007','008','009','010','011','012','013','014')) GROUP BY pa.PATID , pa.CATEGORY_CD , pa.CTL_NO UNION SELECT p.PATID , p.CATEGORY_CD , p.CTL_NO , p.up_date FROM pm p INNER JOIN ( SELECT i.PATID , i.CATEGORY_CD , i.CTL_NO , MAX(i.UP_DATE) AS UP_DATE FROM pm i GROUP BY i.PATID , i.CATEGORY_CD , i.CTL_NO ) pmo ON p.PATID = pmo.PATID AND p.CATEGORY_CD = pmo.CATEGORY_CD AND p.CTL_NO = pmo.CTL_NO AND p.UP_DATE = pmo.UP_DATE WHERE p.value = '1' ) ptmp ON pao.PATID = ptmp.PATID AND pao.CATEGORY_CD = ptmp.CATEGORY_CD AND pao.CTL_NO = ptmp.CTL_NO AND pao.REG_DATE = ptmp.UP_DATE GROUP BY pao.PATID , pao.CATEGORY_CD , pao.CTL_NO , pao.REG_DATE ), PAT_ADL_CTL_TMP AS ( SELECT tmp_r.PATID , tmp_r.CATEGORY_CD , tmp_r.CTL_CTG, MAX(TMP_R.UP_DATE) AS UP_DATE, LISTAGG(tmp_r.CTL_NO || ':(' || TMP_R.VALUE_STRS || ')', '/') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY tmp_r.CTL_NO) AS result_str FROM PAT_ADL_TEMP tmp_r INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )) s on s.PATID=tmp_r.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' GROUP BY tmp_r.PATID, tmp_r.CATEGORY_CD , tmp_r.CTL_CTG) {1} SELECT a.PATID , CASE a.CTL_CTG WHEN '心身状況' THEN 18 WHEN 'ADL' THEN 19 END AS CTL_NO, -2 AS EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_1, 'ADL' AS EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_1, CASE a.CTL_CTG WHEN '心身状況' THEN '2-1' WHEN 'ADL' THEN '3-2' END AS EVENT_CATEGORY_CD_2, a.CTL_CTG AS EVENT_CATEGORY_NAME_2, a.CTL_CTG AS TEMPLATE_NAME, 0 AS USE_TYPE, TO_CHAR(MAX(a.UP_DATE),'yyyymmdd') AS REG_DATE, TO_CHAR( CAST( MAX(a.UP_DATE) AS TIMESTAMP ) AT LOCAL, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM' ) AS UP_DATE, '' as INPUT_PARAMS, '' as TEMPLATE_CD, LISTAGG(a.CATEGORY_CD || '@' || a.result_str, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY a.CATEGORY_CD) AS RESULT_PARAMS, MAX(a.UP_DATE) AS UP_TIME FROM PAT_ADL_CTL_TMP a inner join PAT_BASIC_INFO ba on ( a.PATID = ba.PATID and ba.DEL_FLG <> '1' and not exists(select * from PAT_BASIC_INFO bat where ba.PATID = bat.PATID and ba.REG_DATE < bat.REG_DATE)) WHERE 1=1 {2} GROUP BY a.PATID, a.CTL_CTG

ANS_PATTERN, 0 AS IS_CMT, 1 AS EDITION_NO, 1 AS MAINTE_TYPE, MAINTE_CONTENT_2 FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TRANSLATE(ITEM_NAME,'ｱｲｳｴｵｶｷｸｹｺｻｼｽｾｿﾀﾁﾂﾃﾄﾅﾆﾇﾈﾉﾊﾋﾌﾍﾎﾏﾐﾑﾒﾓﾔﾕﾖﾗﾘﾙﾚﾛﾜｦﾝｧｨｩｪｫｬｭｮｯｰ','アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲンァィゥェォャュョッー' ), '）', ')' ), '（', '(' ) AS ITEM_NAME, DEVICE_TYPE_CD || CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO AS DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CASE WHEN ITEM_KIND = 0 THEN '任意付属品' ELSE 'タイプ別装備' END AS MAINTE_CONTENT_2, ITEM_KIND FROM V_MST_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL WHERE ITEM_KIND IN ( 0, 9 ) AND DEL_FLG = '0' AND SUBSTR( DEVICE_TYPE_CD, 1, 1 ) = '0' ) a GROUP BY ITEM_NAME, MAINTE_CONTENT_2 UNION ALL SELECT DEVICE_TYPE_CD, ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN IS_CMT=1 THEN '( )'||SUPPLEMENT_UNIT ELSE NULL END AS SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, MAINTE_CLASS, ANS_PATTERN, IS_CMT, EDITION_NO, 1 AS MAINTE_TYPE, MAINTE_CONTENT AS MAINTE_CONTENT_2 FROM SYNC_CONV_REASON UNION ALL select LISTAGG ( DEVICE_TYPE_CD, ',' ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD ) AS DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CASE V.CHECK_TYPE WHEN '1' THEN '①'||V.ITEM_NAME WHEN '2' THEN '②'||V.ITEM_NAME WHEN '3' THEN '③'||V.ITEM_NAME WHEN '4' THEN '④'||V.ITEM_NAME ELSE V.ITEM_NAME END ITEM_NAME, SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, 2 AS MAINTE_CLASS, 1 AS ANS_PATTERN, IS_CMT, 1 AS EDITION_NO, 1 AS MAINTE_TYPE, MAINTE_CONTENT_2 from ( SELECT V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD || V.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO as DEVICE_TYPE_CD,V.CHECK_TYPE, REPLACE(REPLACE(TRANSLATE(V.ITEM_NAME, 'ｱｲｳｴｵｶｷｸｹｺｻｼｽｾｿﾀﾁﾂﾃﾄﾅﾆﾇﾈﾉﾊﾋﾌﾍﾎﾏﾐﾑﾒﾓﾔﾕﾖﾗﾘﾙﾚﾛﾜｦﾝｧｨｩｪｫｬｭｮｯｰ', 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲンァィゥェォャュョッー' ), '）', ')' ), '（', '(' ) AS ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN V.ITEM_KIND=4 then '( )'||REPLACE( REPLACE(TRANSLATE(V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, 'ｱｲｳｴｵｶｷｸｹｺｻｼｽｾｿﾀﾁﾂﾃﾄﾅﾆﾇﾈﾉﾊﾋﾌﾍﾎﾏﾐﾑﾒﾓﾔﾕﾖﾗﾘﾙﾚﾛﾜｦﾝｧｨｩｪｫｬｭｮｯｰ', 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲンァィゥェォャュョッー' ), '）', ')' ), '（', '(' ) ELSE REPLACE( REPLACE(TRANSLATE(C.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, 'ｱｲｳｴｵｶｷｸｹｺｻｼｽｾｿﾀﾁﾂﾃﾄﾅﾆﾇﾈﾉﾊﾋﾌﾍﾎﾏﾐﾑﾒﾓﾔﾕﾖﾗﾘﾙﾚﾛﾜｦﾝｧｨｩｪｫｬｭｮｯｰ', 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲンァィゥェォャュョッー' ), '）', ')' ), '（', '(' ) end AS SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, CASE WHEN C.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT IS NOT NULL or v.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_CMT, REPLACE(REPLACE(TRANSLATE(R.ITEM_NAME, 'ｱｲｳｴｵｶｷｸｹｺｻｼｽｾｿﾀﾁﾂﾃﾄﾅﾆﾇﾈﾉﾊﾋﾌﾍﾎﾏﾐﾑﾒﾓﾔﾕﾖﾗﾘﾙﾚﾛﾜｦﾝｧｨｩｪｫｬｭｮｯｰ', 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲンァィゥェォャュョッー' ), '）', ')' ), '（', '(' ) AS MAINTE_CONTENT_2 FROM ( SELECT CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO AS AAA, CASE WHEN NVL( LEAD ( CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO, 1, NULL ) OVER ( ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO ASC ), 99999999 )<CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO THEN 99999999 ELSE NVL( LEAD ( CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO, 1, NULL ) OVER ( ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO ASC ), 99999999 ) END AS LAST, ITEM_KIND, ITEM_NAME, DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO FROM V_MST_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL WHERE ITEM_KIND =1 ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD,CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO) R LEFT JOIN V_MST_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL V ON R.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD AND V.ITEM_KIND IN(2,4) AND V.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO BETWEEN R.AAA AND R.LAST LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEVICE_TYPE_CD, LISTAGG ( SUPPLEMENT_UNIT, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO ) AS SUPPLEMENT_UNIT FROM ( SELECT R.DEVICE_TYPE_CD || R.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO AS DEVICE_TYPE_CD,v.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO, CASE V.ITEM_KIND WHEN '5' THEN V.ITEM_NAME WHEN '3' THEN V.ITEM_NAME||'( )'|| V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT WHEN '7' THEN CASE WHEN SUPPLEMENT_WIDTH2>0 THEN V.ITEM_NAME||'( )'|| V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT||'( )'|| V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT2 ELSE V.ITEM_NAME||'( )'|| V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT|| V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT2 END END AS SUPPLEMENT_UNIT FROM V_MST_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL V LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO AS AAA, CASE WHEN NVL( LEAD ( CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO, 1, NULL ) OVER ( ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO ASC ), 99999999 )<CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO THEN 99999999 ELSE NVL( LEAD ( CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO, 1, NULL ) OVER ( ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO ASC ), 99999999 ) END AS LAST, ITEM_KIND, ITEM_NAME, DEVICE_TYPE_CD, CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO FROM V_MST_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL WHERE ITEM_KIND =2 ORDER BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD,CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO) R ON R.DEVICE_TYPE_CD = V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD AND V.ITEM_KIND IN(3,5,7) AND V.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO BETWEEN R.AAA AND R.LAST WHERE SUBSTR(V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD, 1, 1) = '0' AND V.DEL_FLG = '0' ) GROUP BY DEVICE_TYPE_CD) C ON C.DEVICE_TYPE_CD=V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD || V.CHECKLIST_ITEM_NO WHERE SUBSTR(V.DEVICE_TYPE_CD, 1, 1) = '0' AND V.DEL_FLG = '0' ) v GROUP BY V.CHECK_TYPE,V.ITEM_NAME,V.SUPPLEMENT_UNIT,V.MAINTE_CONTENT_2,IS_CMT) a left join SYNC_CHECKLIST_PERIOD_DETAIL b on a.MAINTE_CONTENT_2=b.NAME and b.MAINTE_TYPE=1 ORDER BY b.NO

tableInfo.name: よく使う施設マスタ
tableInfo.sqlForTool:
WITH MST_FACILITY_INFO AS ( SELECT BASE.FACILITY_CD,BASE.FACILITY_NAME,LPAD(BASE.PREF_CD, 2, '0') AS PREF_CD FROM MST_FACILITY BASE WHERE ( BASE.UP_DATE, BASE.FACILITY_CD ) =( SELECT MAX(X.UP_DATE), X.FACILITY_CD FROM MST_FACILITY X WHERE BASE.FACILITY_CD = X.FACILITY_CD GROUP BY X.FACILITY_CD ) ),PATID_LIST as ( SELECT DISTINCT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM ( SELECT PATID, FROM_SERIES_CD AS SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN UNION ALL SELECT PATID, TO_SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_MOVE_PLAN {STATUS} UNION ALL SELECT PATID, SERIES_CD FROM SYS_PAT_SERIES_FACILITY where MAIN_FLG='1' )), FACILITY_DATA AS ( SELECT FACILITY_NAME, MAX(UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, NULL AS PREF_CD, COUNT(FACILITY_NAME) as count1 FROM ( SELECT PATID,FACILITY_NAME, UP_DATE FROM PAT_INTRODUCTION a WHERE FACILITY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_INTRODUCTION b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT PATID,FACILITY_NAME, UP_DATE FROM PAT_INOUT a WHERE FACILITY_CD IS NULL AND FACILITY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PAT_INOUT b WHERE a.PATID=b.PATID AND a.CTL_NO=b.CTL_NO AND a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) ) combined_tables INNER JOIN PATID_LIST s on s.PATID = combined_tables.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' GROUP BY FACILITY_NAME ), FACILITY_DATA_1 AS ( SELECT fd.FACILITY_NAME, fd.UP_DATE, mfi.PREF_CD, fd.count1 FROM FACILITY_DATA fd LEFT JOIN MST_FACILITY_INFO mfi ON fd.FACILITY_NAME = mfi.FACILITY_NAME
), FACILITY_DATA_2 AS ( SELECT f.FACILITY_NAME, p.UP_DATE, f.PREF_CD, p.count2 FROM ( SELECT FACILITY_CD, MAX(UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, COUNT(FACILITY_CD) as count2 FROM PAT_INOUT a INNER JOIN PATID_LIST s on s.PATID = a.PATID and s.SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' WHERE FACILITY_CD IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FACILITY_CD ) p INNER JOIN MST_FACILITY_INFO f ON f.FACILITY_CD = p.FACILITY_CD ), COMBINED_DATA AS ( SELECT FACILITY_NAME, UP_DATE, PREF_CD, count1, 0 as count2 FROM FACILITY_DATA_1 UNION ALL SELECT FACILITY_NAME, UP_DATE, PREF_CD, 0 as count1, count2 FROM FACILITY_DATA_2 ), AGGREGATED_DATA AS ( SELECT FACILITY_NAME, MAX(UP_DATE) as UP_DATE, PREF_CD, SUM(count1) + SUM(count2) as TOTAL_COUNT FROM COMBINED_DATA GROUP BY FACILITY_NAME,PREF_CD ) {1} SELECT FACILITY_NAME, UP_DATE, PREF_CD FROM AGGREGATED_DATA a where 1=1 {2} ORDER BY TOTAL_COUNT DESC, FACILITY_NAME
